verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: Texas reports first equine infection of New World screwworm on ranch horse
title.zh: 德州报告首例新世界螺旋线虫感染马匹病例

summary.en: A horse in southern Texas has been diagnosed with the New World screwworm, marking the first equine infection in the US. Health authorities are working to contain the outbreak of this flesh-eating parasite, which was found on the hind limb of a working ranch horse.
summary.zh: 德州南部的一匹马被诊断感染新世界螺旋线虫，这是美国首例马匹感染病例。卫生部门正在努力控制这种食肉寄生虫的疫情，该寄生虫在一匹工作牧马的后肢上被发现。

body.en: The flesh-eating parasite had been largely eradicated, but now authorities are racing to contain an outbreak A horse in southern Texas has been infected with the New World screwworm, marking the first US equine infection as health authorities race to contain an outbreak of the flesh-eating parasite. The pest was discovered on the hind limb of a working ranch horse in Presidio county, according to a statement on Thursday from US Equestrian Foundation. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这种食肉寄生虫已基本被根除，但现在当局正在加紧遏制疫情爆发德克萨斯州南部的一匹马感染了新大陆螺旋虫，这是美国卫生当局竞相遏制这种食肉寄生虫爆发的第一例马感染病例。根据美国马术基金会周四的一份声明，这种害虫是在普雷西迪奥县一匹工作的牧场马的后肢上发现的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of the New World screwworm on a ranch horse in Texas brings to mind the vulnerability of living creatures to disease and decay. In times of such afflictions, the wisdom of James reminds us to turn to prayer and community support, seeking healing and strength from Yahweh for both the animal and those who care for it.
reflection.zh: 在新世界螺旋线虫感染德州牧马的消息传来之际，我们体会到生灵在疾病和衰败面前的脆弱。在这样的困境中，雅各书的智慧提醒我们转向祈祷和社群支持，为受苦的牲畜和照顾它们的人寻求雅伟的医治与力量。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Nepal continues looking for survivors in hydropower tunnels two weeks after deadly floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔在致命洪水两周后继续在水电隧道中搜寻幸存者

summary.en: Nepal, which has contributed little to the emissions driving global warming, said reconstruction could cost billions. Rescuers are still searching for survivors in hydropower tunnels two weeks after a glacial mountain collapse triggered deadly flooding.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔表示，尽管其对导致全球变暖的排放贡献甚微，但重建可能需要数十亿美元。在冰川山体崩塌引发的致命洪水两周后，救援人员仍在水电隧道中搜寻幸存者。

body.en:
Nepali rescuers clung to hopes of finding survivors trapped in hydropower tunnels on Wednesday, two weeks after deadly flooding triggered by a glacial mountain collapse.

The 26 August tsunami-like surge of water, mud and debris — which began on the China-Nepal border — has killed 1,377 people and left 5,130, including 587 foreigners, missing, according to Nepali authorities.

"The rescue and search work in the tunnels at Trishuli 3A, 3B and Chilime hydropower projects is ongoing," Nepal Army spokesman Raja Ram Basnet told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency.

The number of Australians unaccounted for remains at 35 , and Australian government officials and disaster response personnel have been deployed to Nepal to support response efforts. Neither Nepal nor China has confirmed that any Australians are among the deceased.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Australia’s Disaster Assistance and Response Team (DART) has conducted mapping and thermal searches in the disaster-hit region, including the last known locations of some missing Australians.

Three people were rescued from deep inside hydropower tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday.

Authorities appealed on Wednesday for overseas family members of the missing — preferably parents or children — to submit DNA samples via email.

A public notice outlined specific types of genetic tests the family members should seek out depending on their sex and relationship to the missing person.

Thousands of people displaced by the disaster are living in camps, and the charity Save the Children said as many as 540 children had been separated from their parents.

Nepal police said they were taking extra care to ensure the safety of children and women in relief camps.

"We have become more vigilant in temporary holding centres in the affected areas where there are children, women or minority groups who could be victims of sexual abuse," said Nepal Police spokesman Abi Narayan Kafle.

"We have also started providing psychosocial counselling in different camps," he told AFP.

While the exact cause of the glacial collapse is unclear, climate change is accelerating glacial melt worldwide and increasing the risk of such disasters.

Nepal, a largely rural nation of 30 million people that has contributed little to the greenhouse gas emissions driving global warming, has said reconstruction could cost billions of dollars.

Kafle said security personnel have involved community members to search for bodies feared buried under debris.

"We have started a special search campaign for missing bodies all across the Bhotekoshi river corridor," he said.

reflection.en: Two weeks after the devastating floods in Nepal, the search for survivors continues in hydropower tunnels. Amidst the immense loss of life and the thousands missing, including many foreigners, the urgency to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves is paramount. We pray for the rescuers and for all those affected, that hope may be found amidst the...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔发生毁灭性洪水两周后，水电隧道中的幸存者搜寻仍在继续。在巨大的生命损失和数千人失踪（包括许多外国人）的背景下，为那些无法为自己发声的人发声的紧迫性至关重要。我们为救援人员以及所有受影响的人祈祷，愿在毁灭中找到希望。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Coach crash kills several people in Swiss Alps
title.zh: 瑞士阿尔卑斯山教练车祸致多人死亡

summary.en: A tourist coach carrying 48 Dutch passengers overturned in the south-eastern Swiss Alps, resulting in several fatalities and injuries. Rescue teams were deployed to the scene.
summary.zh: 在瑞士东南部阿尔卑斯山，一辆载有48名荷兰乘客的旅游巴士发生侧翻，导致数人死亡，多人受伤。救援队伍已被派往现场。

body.en:
A tourist coach has crashed in the south-eastern Swiss Alps, leaving several people dead and several injured, local police say.

The bus overturned between Susch and Zernez in the Graubünden - also known as Grisons - region late on Thursday afternoon.

A large team of rescuers equipped with several helicopters was deployed to the scene.

Some 48 Dutch passengers were on board the bus, according to a spokeswoman for the General Dutch Association of Travel Companies on behalf of tour operator OAD.

The spokesperson told Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf they could not yet say how many people had been killed or injured.

Images on Swiss news sites show a coach lying on its side beside a narrow country road on which stand numerous ambulances while groups of rescuers work at the scene.

The coach reportedly left the Netherlands on Monday and was on a day trip to Switzerland from Austria when the crash happened.

In a post on X, Swiss President Guy Parmelin said he was "deeply shocked" by the incident and offered his "sincere condolences" to the families of the victims.

Zernez is the entry point for visitors to the Swiss National Park, a vast Alpine reserve stretching more than 100 sq km (40 sq miles) across the mountainous Engadine valley.
body.zh: 当地警方称，一辆旅游巴士在瑞士东南部阿尔卑斯山坠毁，造成多人死亡、多人受伤。 周四下午晚些时候，这辆巴士在格劳宾登州（也称为格劳宾登州）地区的苏施和采尔内斯之间翻车。 配备多架直升机的大批救援人员被部署到现场。 代表旅游运营商 OAD 的荷兰旅游公司总协会发言人表示，巴士上约有 48 名荷兰乘客。 该发言人告诉荷兰报纸《De Telegraaf》，他们目前还无法透露有多少人死亡或受伤。 瑞士新闻网站上的图片显示，一辆客车侧躺在一条狭窄的乡村道路旁，路上停着许多救护车，成群的救援人员正在现场工作。 据报道，事故发生时，该教练周一离开荷兰，正在从奥地利前往瑞士进行一日游。 策尔内茨是游客进入瑞士国家公园的入口，这是一个广阔的高山保护区，绵延 100 多平方公里（40 平方英里），横跨多山的恩嘎丁山谷。

reflection.en: The news from the Swiss Alps is a stark reminder of life's fragility and the suddenness with which joy can turn to sorrow. In moments of such profound loss, we are reminded of the heavenly promise that Yahweh will wipe away every tear, and death shall be no more. May those grieving find solace in that ultimate hope.
reflection.zh: 瑞士阿尔卑斯山传来的消息，严峻地提醒我们生命的脆弱，以及欢乐如何突然转变为悲伤。在如此深切的失落时刻，我们被提醒天上的应许——雅伟将擦去一切眼泪，死亡将不再存在。愿那些哀恸的人们能在那终极的盼望中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

body.en: The execution of Daniel Owen Conahan Jr makes him the state’s 15th person executed this year A Florida man was executed by lethal injection on Thursday after being convicted of one of a series of suspected killings that became known as the Hog Trail Murders in the 1990s. Daniel Owen Conahan Jr, 72, was sentenced to death for the 1996 kidnapping and strangling of Richard Allen Montgomery. Authorities found Montgomery’s mutilated body in a wooded south-west Florida area where the remains of at least six people have been found over a three-year span. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The execution of Daniel Owen Conahan Jr. brings a legal conclusion to the horrific "Hog Trail Murders." This case, involving the mutilation and discovery of multiple bodies, underscores the profound human need for justice in the face of unspeakable evil. Yet, as we confront such darkness, we are reminded of the divine call to "act justly and to love mercy...
reflection.zh: 丹尼尔·欧文·科纳汉的处决为可怕的“野猪小径谋杀案”带来了法律上的了结。此案涉及多具尸体的残缺和发现，凸显了人类面对无法言喻的邪恶时对正义的深刻需求。然而，当我们面对如此黑暗时，我们被提醒雅伟的呼召：“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行。”

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的长期盟友乔·迪吉诺瓦已辞去他领导的一个司法部调查职务，该调查涉及前执法和情报官员涉嫌合谋反对总统的指控。迪吉诺瓦表示，他的离职与对“报复性案件”进展不够快的担忧有关，其他特朗普忠诚者也有同感。

body.en: Joe diGenova led investigation focused on intelligence assessment that Russia interfered in 2016 election A longtime ally of Donald Trump resigned from his post leading a Department of Justice investigation into whether former law enforcement and intelligence officials conspired against the Republican president. “Sometimes people want things done faster and that’s all you can do,” Joe diGenova said on Thursday. He appeared to be referring to concerns among other Trump loyalists that the president’s retribution cases were not moving quickly enough. Continue reading...

Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that righteous rulers establish justice, implying that the process itself, not just the outcome, must be sound...
reflection.zh: 乔·迪吉诺瓦辞去司法部一项调查的领导职务，据称是由于对“报复性案件”进展缓慢感到不耐烦，这引发了对领导层诚信和追求正义的质疑。《箴言》16:12提醒我们，正直的君王以公正治国，这意味着过程本身，而不仅仅是结果，必须是健全和符合道德的。

title.en: Houthi rebels seize strategic port city in Yemen, escalating US-Iran crisis
title.zh: 胡塞武装占领也门战略港口城市，加剧美伊危机

summary.en: The Houthi rebel group has taken control of Yemen's port city of Mocha, a key location for controlling shipping through the Red Sea. This strategic waterway is vital for global energy supplies, and its control by rebels escalates the ongoing conflict in the region and contributes to rising oil prices worldwide.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装组织已控制也门港口城市摩卡，该地是控制红海航运的关键地点。这条战略水道对全球能源供应至关重要，其被叛军控制加剧了该地区的持续冲突，并导致全球油价上涨。

body.en:
The Houthi rebel group has taken over Yemen's port city of Mocha, an area vital to controlling shipping through the Red Sea, Houthi and Yemeni officials say.

Mocha is about 80km from the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a strategic waterway between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden through which about 12 per cent of the world's oil and other goods are shipped.

The Bab el-Mandeb has become even more important for global energy supplies since shipping through the nearby Strait of Hormuz was disrupted by Iran after it was attacked by the United States and Israel in February.

The Houthi rebels' takeover of Mocha was confirmed to the Associated Press by Ahmed Baash, a commander with the National Resistance Forces allied with Yemen's government, and Hazam al-Assad, a member of the Houthis' political bureau.

Yemeni government military sources said the Houthis had gained further ‌leverage over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, the southern outlet of the Red Sea, and had reached the islands of Hanish.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Middle East war has sucked in Yemen, the energy-rich Gulf and others across the region while roiling the world economy, as oil prices hit US$104 a barrel on Friday.

The fighting in Yemen has killed more than 500 people since the Houthis launched a major offensive last week to seize territory around the Bab al-Mandab strait, gateway to the Red Sea shipping route.

The rebels , who have been attacking Saudi oil tankers , are trying to tighten their squeeze on the shipments, analysts say — a lifeline for exports after Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz .

Mocha represents the Houthis biggest territorial gain since a truce signed in 2022 to end a civil war in Yemen that lasted more than a decade.

Red Sea navigation is safe for all shipping companies except for Saudi vessels, Yemen's Houthi-run humanitarian ‌operations co-ordination centre said in a statement.

Saudi Arabia has relied on the Red Sea shipping route since the Iran conflict effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of global oil used to flow.

Houthi spokesman Mohammed Abdulsalam said that operations were defensive and would stop once attacks on Yemen stopped.

Yemeni government forces and their allies are relocating south along the Red Sea coast to Dhubab, which sits directly on the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, across from the island of ‌Perim, government military sources told Reuters.

Control of Dhubab and the island is key to gaining hold of the strait, they said.

Bab el-Mandeb, or the Gate of Tears - named for its perilous navigation conditions - lies between Yemen on the Arabian Peninsula and Djibouti and Eritrea on the...
body.zh: 胡塞武装和也门官员表示，胡塞叛乱组织已经占领了也门港口城市摩卡，该地区对于控制红海航运至关重要。 摩卡距离曼德海峡约 80 公里，曼德海峡是红海和亚丁湾之间的战略水道，世界上约 12% 的石油和其他货物都通过该海峡运输。 曼德海峡对于全球能源供应变得更加重要，因为附近的霍尔木兹海峡的航运在二月份遭到美国和以色列的袭击后受到伊朗的干扰。 与也门政府结盟的民族抵抗军指挥官艾哈迈德·巴什和胡塞政治局成员哈扎姆·阿萨德向美联社证实了胡塞叛军接管摩卡的消息。 也门政府军方消息人士称，胡塞武装在红海南部出口曼德海峡获得了进一步的影响力，并已到达哈尼什群岛。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 中东战争波及也门、能源丰富的海湾地区和该地区其他国家，同时扰乱了世界经济，周五油价触及每桶 104 美元。 自胡塞武装上周发起大规模攻势，夺取通往红海航线的曼德海峡周边领土以来，也门的战斗已造成 500 多人死亡。 分析人士称，一直在袭击沙特油轮的叛乱分子正试图加强对石油运输的挤压——这是伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡后出口的生命线。 摩卡是胡塞武装自 2022 年签署休战协议以结束也门持续十多年的内战以来获得的最大领土。 也门胡塞武装人道主义行动协调中心在一份声明中表示，除沙特船只外，红海航行对所有航运公司来说都是安全的。 自伊朗冲突有效关闭霍尔木兹海峡以来，沙特阿拉伯一直依赖红海航线，全球五分之一的石油曾经通过该海峡流动。 胡塞武装发言人穆罕默德·阿卜杜勒萨拉姆表示，行动是防御性的，一旦对也门的袭击停止，行动就会停止。 政府军方消息人士告诉路透社，也门政府军及其盟友正在沿着红海沿岸向南迁移到杜巴布（Dhubab），该地直接位于曼德海峡，与佩林岛隔海相望。 他们说，控制杜巴布岛和该岛是控制该海峡的关键。 曼德门（Bab el-Mandeb），或称“泪水之门”，因其危险的航行条件而得名，位于阿拉伯半岛的也门与阿拉伯半岛的吉布提和厄立特里亚之间。

reflection.en: The seizure of Mocha by Houthi rebels highlights how regional conflicts ripple outward, impacting global trade and energy security. In times of escalating war and economic instability, Psalm 46:9 offers a profound reminder that ultimate power rests with God, who will ultimately bring an end to earthly conflicts and disarm the nations.
reflection.zh: 胡塞武装占领摩卡，凸显了地区冲突如何波及全球贸易和能源安全。在战争升级和经济不稳定的时期，《诗篇》46:9 提醒我们，最终的权柄在于雅伟，祂将终结地上的冲突，使万国放下武器。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Man jailed after threatening to kill son's teacher in French village
title.zh: 男子因威胁杀害儿子老师被判入狱

summary.en: A father in a French village has been sentenced to six months in prison for threatening to kill a primary school teacher who had disciplined his son. The incident occurred six days before the fast-track hearing, prompting the French Education Minister to emphasize the need for teachers to feel safe.
summary.zh: 法国一村庄的父亲因威胁要杀死管教他儿子的某小学教师而被判处六个月监禁。事件发生在快速审理的六天前，法国教育部长对此事强调了教师需要感到安全的重要性。

body.en:
A man has been given a six-month jail term in France after he threatened to kill a female primary school teacher who had disciplined his son at a village primary school.

He was sentenced after a fast-track hearing on Thursday, six days after the events unfolded in Le Fauga, a village with a population of about 2,600 just outside the southwestern city of Toulouse.

French Education Minister Edouard Geffray said: "No teacher should be afraid to do their job. Attacking one of them is attacking the entire institution."

Over the summer, Geffray steered through a law aimed at protecting staff from a "significant risk" to their safety or health from a member of a student's family.

The case revives terrible memories in France of the beheading of a teacher in the Paris suburb of Conflans-Sainte-Honorine six years ago. Samuel Paty was murdered outside his school by an 18-year-old Chechen refugee.

In Le Fauga, the teacher's colleagues did not go into work on Monday because of what had happened the previous Friday.

The threat was made after the man had been called in for a chat with the school, according to Toulouse education chief Karim Benmiloud.

Le Fauga Mayor Jean-Marie Puig told BFMTV that the man's son had been disruptive in class and the teacher had sent him to another class to calm down, although he continued to misbehave.

The teacher in this class was alleged to have told the child to "stop acting like a little bully", BFMTV reports.

She was then threatened by the father, who according to the mayor had waited for her "outside the school and apparently threatened to cut off her head if she'd been a man".

The parent subsequently apologised, however a judicial complaint was made and he went before the prosecutor in Toulouse on Thursday afternoon.

The decree passed in July allows for a student to be transferred to another school in a case involving significant risk to staff, and where education authorities have intervened.

It is thought the boy and a younger sister may now be moved to another school outside Le Fauga.
body.zh: 法国一名男子因威胁要杀死一名在乡村小学管教他儿子的女小学教师而被判处六个月监禁。 周四，Le Fauga 事件发生六天后，他在快速听证会后被判刑。Le Fauga 是西南部城市图卢兹郊外的一个人口约 2,600 人的村庄。 法国教育部长爱德华·格弗雷(Edouard Geffray)表示：“任何教师都不应该害怕做好自己的工作。攻击其中一个人就是攻击整个机构。” 今年夏天，杰弗雷主导通过了一项法律，旨在保护教职员工免受学生家庭成员的安全或健康“重大风险”。 此案勾起了法国人对六年前在巴黎郊区孔夫兰圣奥诺里讷一名教师被斩首的可怕记忆。塞缪尔·帕蒂 (Samuel Paty) 在学校外被一名 18 岁的车臣难民谋杀。 在Le Fauga，由于上周五发生的事情，老师的同事周一没有上班。 图卢兹教育主管卡里姆·本米卢德表示，这名男子是在被学校叫去谈话后发出威胁的。 Le Fauga 市长 Jean-Marie Puig 告诉 BFMTV，该男子的儿子在课堂上捣乱，老师已把他送到另一个班级冷静下来，但他的行为仍然不端。 据 BFMTV 报道，该班老师据称曾告诉孩子“不要表现得像个小恶霸”。 然后她受到父亲的威胁，据市长称，父亲“在学校外面等她，并威胁说，如果她是男人，就要砍掉她的头”。 这名家长随后道歉，但随后提出了司法申诉，并于周四下午在图卢兹接受了检察官的审判。 7 月通过的法令允许在对教职员工构成重大风险且教育当局进行干预的情况下将学生转移到另一所学校。 据认为，这名男孩和一个妹妹现在可能会被转移到 Le Fauga 以外的另一所学校。

reflection.en: In Le Fauga, France, a father's rage over his son's discipline led to a death threat against a teacher. This immediate escalation, where a perceived slight is met with violent intent, echoes the ancient warning: 'All who draw the sword will die by the sword.' Such reactions, while born of human frustration, bypass the path of dialogue and reconciliation,...
reflection.zh: 在法国的勒福加，一位父亲因儿子受到的管教而勃然大怒，向一位教师发出了死亡威胁。这种将感知到的冒犯立即升级为暴力意图的行为，呼应了古老的警告：“凡动刀的，必死在刀下。” 这种反应，尽管源于人类的沮丧，却绕过了对话与和解的道路，最终伤害了所有相关人员。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: 'Disfiguring': Behind the growing spread of a flesh-eating ulcer
title.zh: “毁容性”：食肉溃疡蔓延的背后

summary.en: A growing number of Buruli ulcer cases is prompting fresh research into prevention.
summary.zh: 日益增多的布鲁里溃疡病例正促使人们对预防措施进行新的研究。

body.en:
Warmer weather has arrived, and mosquitoes will be buzzing about before you know it. As El Niño is expected to bring an early start to summer heat, it’s likely mosquitoes will make their presence felt earlier than usual.

The threat of mosquitoes depositing flesh-eating bacteria has been restricted to a few parts of the country. But while rare, research shows it is now showing up in more areas — including in backyards in Melbourne’s inner city.

So what exactly is Buruli ulcer, where is it now found, and how can you prevent it? Here’s what we know so far, and what researchers are currently developing to protect against the bacteria in future.

Buruli ulcer is a skin infection resulting from the bacterium Mycobacterium ulcerans.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It starts as small and often painless inflammation after a mosquito bite, which may not be seen until months after initial infection. It transforms into a disfiguring ulcer after many weeks.

If left untreated, it can continue increasing in size with a loss of skin and muscle.

A buruli ulcer is treated with an eight-week course of antibiotics. Recovery can be much slower than expected for other common skin infections, with healing time highly dependent on the condition of the ulcer when first treated. It may take more than four months for ulcers to heal.

Mycobacterium ulcerans can infect urban wildlife, such as possums, which suffer symptoms similar to those in humans.

The mosquito most closely associated with areas at risk of Mycobacterium ulcerans is Aedes notoscriptus. Commonly known as the Australian backyard mosquito, it is widespread in Australia and commonly found in water-holding containers in suburban areas.

There may be other pathways of infection, but health authorities have strongly encouraged people to prevent mosquito bites as the best way to avoid Buruli ulcer.

Buruli ulcer has been reported in more than 30 countries around the world, including in Africa, South America and the Western Pacific.

In Australia, it has been reported in several states, territories and regions, including Victoria, Far North Queensland, the Northern Territory and New South Wales.

Victoria has been hit hardest, with 426 cases reported in the state in 2025 alone.

Victorian cases have mostly been reported from coastal regions, but Melbourne’s suburbs have also seen an increase in activity. Inner north-west suburbs such as Essendon, Brunswick West and Moonee Ponds are part of the new cluster.

With the potential for more cases, and in more locations, surveillance beyond known areas of activity is needed.

Since Buruli ulcer became a notifiable disease in...
body.zh: 天气转暖，不知不觉间蚊子就开始嗡嗡作响。由于厄尔尼诺现象预计将提早进入夏季，因此蚊子可能会比平常更早出现。 蚊子传播食肉细菌的威胁仅限于该国的少数地区。尽管罕见，但研究表明它现在出现在更多地区——包括墨尔本内城区的后院。 那么布鲁里溃疡到底是什么，它现在在哪里发现，以及如何预防它？以下是我们迄今为止所了解的情况，以及研究人员目前正在开发的预防未来细菌感染的方法。 布鲁里溃疡是由溃疡分枝杆菌引起的皮肤感染。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 被蚊子叮咬后，它开始为小且通常无痛的炎症，可能要到初次感染几个月后才会出现。几周后它会转变为毁容性溃疡。 如果不及时治疗，它会继续增大，并导致皮肤和肌肉损失。 布鲁里溃疡需接受为期八周的抗生素治疗。其他常见皮肤感染的恢复速度可能比预期慢得多，愈合时间很大程度上取决于首次治疗时溃疡的状况。溃疡可能需要四个多月才能愈合。 溃疡分枝杆菌可以感染城市野生动物，例如负鼠，它们会出现与人类相似的症状。 与溃疡分枝杆菌风险区域关系最密切的蚊子是伊蚊。它通常被称为澳大利亚后院蚊子，在澳大利亚广泛分布，常见于郊区的盛水容器中。 可能还有其他感染途径，但卫生当局强烈鼓励人们预防蚊虫叮咬，这是避免布鲁里溃疡的最佳方法。 全球有 30 多个国家报告了布鲁里溃疡，包括非洲、南美洲和西太平洋地区。 在澳大利亚，包括维多利亚州、远北昆士兰州、北领地和新南威尔士州在内的多个州、领地和地区均报告了这种情况。 维多利亚州受到的打击最为严重，仅 2025 年该州就报告了 426 例病例。 维多利亚州的病例主要来自沿海地区，但墨尔本郊区的病例也有所增加。埃森登 (Essendon)、布伦瑞克西 (Brunswick West) 和穆尼池塘 (Moonee Ponds) 等内西北郊区是新集群的一部分。 由于可能会在更多地点出现更多病例，因此需要在已知活动区域之外进行监测。 自从布鲁里溃疡成为法定传染病以来...

reflection.en: The spread of Buruli ulcer, a disfiguring bacterial infection, highlights the ongoing challenges of disease and the importance of scientific research. In the face of such afflictions, the biblical call to pray for the sick and support those working towards healing offers a path of hope and practical compassion. May those affected find relief and recovery,...
reflection.zh: 布鲁里溃疡是一种毁容性的细菌感染，其传播的蔓延凸显了疾病带来的持续挑战以及科学研究的重要性。面对这样的病痛，圣经中呼吁为病人祈祷并支持那些致力于治愈的人，这提供了一条充满希望和实际关怀的道路。愿受影响的人们找到缓解和康复，愿研究工作带来有效的预防和治疗。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: From 'inside job' to 'deep state': The conspiracy legacy of 9/11
title.zh: 9/11 成为挥之不去的阴谋论

summary.en: Twenty-five years after the 9/11 attacks, the influence of early internet conspiracy films like 'Loose Change' remains a subject of debate, demonstrating the enduring power of such theories.
summary.zh: 9/11事件发生二十五年后，像《Loose Change》这样的早期互联网阴谋论电影的影响力仍然是一个有争议的话题，这表明了此类理论持久的力量。

body.en:
Korey Rowe was on his first day of basic training for the United States Army when planes struck the World Trade Center on 11 September 2001.

"I thought that was how every first day started — with alarms," he tells SBS News.

"Then I learned, as they pulled us into a room and turned the TV on, that this was a major event."

The attacks killed 2,977 people and injured thousands more, with victims from more than 90 countries.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Four months later, the 18-year-old was in Afghanistan as part of the US-led invasion launched in response to the attacks. He would later serve in Iraq, where the US went to war in 2003 after the Bush administration and its allies alleged Saddam Hussein's government possessed weapons of mass destruction.

No stockpiles were found after the invasion, and subsequent investigations identified significant failures in the intelligence used to assess Iraq's weapons programs .

It's estimated that nearly a million people were killed by post-9/11 war violence in Iraq, Afghanistan, Syria, Yemen and Pakistan between 2001 and 2003, including more than 400,000 civilians, according to research compiled by Brown University.

Around the time of his deployment, he was quoted in a newspaper in upstate New York, where he grew up, saying terrorism had to be "dealt with".

Before he was due to deploy for a third tour of the Middle East in 2005, Rowe deserted the army, slipping out of Fort Campbell, on the Kentucky-Tennessee border, during the night.

He drove to Washington DC, where he linked up with his childhood best friend, Dylan Avery.

The pair committed themselves to a project they had already begun: a documentary about September 11.

Made on a shoestring budget, the film presented a series of claims challenging the accepted account of the September 11 attacks. It promoted theories suggesting the attacks were a false flag operation orchestrated by the US government.

It quickly spread through torrent sites and on Google Video — then one of the emerging online video platforms — attracting millions of views when social media was still in its infancy.

The film's reach helped turn a collection of existing 9/11 conspiracy claims into a mass online phenomenon.

Loose Change was not the only conspiracy documentary about 9/11. But it became one of the movement's most influential films, with Vanity Fair later describing it as the "first internet blockbuster".

Another innovation of the film was encouraging viewers to scrutinise official accounts themselves, an approach that has become a defining feature of online conspiracy culture.

The phrase "do your own research" would later become...
body.zh: 2001 年 9 月 11 日，飞机袭击世贸中心时，科里·罗正在进行美国陆军基础训练的第一天。 “我以为这就是每一天的开始——伴随着警报，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “然后，当他们把我们拉进一个房间并打开电视时，我才知道这是一件大事。” 四个月后，这位 18 岁的年轻人参加了美国领导的针对袭击事件发起的入侵行动。后来，他在伊拉克服役。2003 年，布什政府及其盟友指控萨达姆·侯赛因政府拥有大规模杀伤性武器，美国在那里爆发了战争。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 入侵后没有发现任何库存，随后的调查发现用于评估伊拉克武器计划的情报存在重大失误。 在他被部署期间，他长大的纽约州北部的一家报纸援引他的话说，必须“应对”恐怖主义。 2005 年，在他第三次出征中东之前，罗逃离了军队，连夜溜出了肯塔基州和田纳西州边境的坎贝尔堡。 他开车前往华盛顿特区，在那里与他儿时最好的朋友迪伦·艾弗里 (Dylan Avery) 会合。 两人致力于一个已经开始的项目：一部关于 9 月 11 日的纪录片。 该片预算有限，提出了一系列主张，挑战了对 9 月 11 日袭击事件的公认说法。它宣扬的理论表明这些攻击是美国政府精心策划的假旗行动。 它通过种子网站和谷歌视频（当时新兴的在线视频平台之一）迅速传播，在社交媒体仍处于起步阶段时吸引了数百万次观看。 这部电影的影响力使一系列现有的 9/11 阴谋论变成了一种大规模的网络现象。 《Loose Change》并不是唯一一部关于 9/11 的阴谋纪录片。但它成为该运动最具影响力的电影之一，《名利场》后来将其描述为“第一部互联网大片”。 这部电影的另一项创新是鼓励观众自己审查官方账户，这种做法已成为网络阴谋文化的一个决定性特征。 从 COVID-19 错误信息到政治阴谋论，“自己研究”这句话后来变得无处不在。 袭击发生二十五年后，“宽松变革”流行的理论已被彻底揭穿。 然而，助长他们的不信任——对政府、强大的精英和官方解释——依然存在。 此后的几十年里，阴谋论已经成为......

reflection.en: The enduring nature of 9/11 conspiracy theories, as highlighted by the film 'Loose Change,' speaks to a persistent human struggle with discerning truth from falsehood. In a world saturated with information, the call to seek wisdom and critically evaluate what we consume remains as vital as ever.
reflection.zh: 《Loose Change》等电影所揭示的9/11阴谋论的持久性，反映了人类在辨别真伪方面持续的挣扎。在一个信息泛滥的世界里，寻求智慧和批判性地评估我们所接收的内容的呼吁，仍然像以往一样至关重要。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: More than 20 children killed in DR Congo school fire
title.zh: 刚果民主共和国学校火灾，20多名儿童恐丧生

summary.en: Officials say there was a stampede as they fled a fire that engulfed two schools in the eastern rebel-held city of Bukavu.
summary.zh: 官员称，在东部反政府武装控制的城市布卡武，一场吞噬了两所学校的大火引发了踩踏事件。

body.en:
At least 24 schoolchildren have died in a stampede as they tried to flee a fire that engulfed two schools in rebel-held Bukavu in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, officials there have said.

Adults are also reported to have died in the fire and there are fears that the death toll could rise further in the densely populated Kadutu commune.

Survivors have been taken to nearby hospitals, and footage of the scene shows children lying on hospital floors in pain.

Some 300 houses have also been destroyed in the fire, the cause of which is unknown.

Rebel‑appointed authorities released a provisional death toll of 24 on Thursday evening, confirming previous reports, but there are fears that more people may have died.

Pictures circulating on social media show young children lying motionless on the ground.

A witness quoted by Reuters news agency said the fire had been put out by afternoon but smoke was still rising from rubble and corrugated metal.

Bukavu, the capital of South Kivu province and one of DR Congo's most crowded hillside cities, was captured by M23 rebels in February last year.

Meanwhile the government in Kinshasa released a statement on X, without specifying numbers of casualties.

"The Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship expressed deep sorrow over the deadly fire," it said.

"With several lives lost and many injured, the toll remains provisional. The minister offered condolences, affirmed solidarity with families, and ordered assessments of affected schools to ensure learning continuity."

The tragedy follows a similar fire in Kinshasa last weekend, where residents died in a stampede at a wedding banquet hall.

In response, the government has ordered strict safety measures and deployed teams nationwide to enforce standards at public gathering places.
body.zh: 刚果民主共和国东部叛军控制的布卡武两所学校发生火灾，当地一名高级官员表示，至少 24 名学童在试图逃离火灾时可能会在踩踏事件中丧生。 据报道，还有成年人在火灾中死亡，人们担心人口稠密的卡杜图公社的死亡人数可能会进一步上升。 幸存者已被送往附近的医院，现场录像显示，孩子们痛苦地躺在医院地板上。 大约300栋房屋也在火灾中被毁，火灾原因尚不清楚。 社交媒体上流传的照片显示，年幼的孩子们躺在地上一动不动。 路透社援引一名目击者的话说，大火已于下午被扑灭，但废墟和波纹金属中仍冒出浓烟。 布卡武是南基伍省首府，也是刚果民主共和国最拥挤的山地城市之一，去年 2 月被“3·23”运动叛军占领。 叛军任命的当局表示，他们正在评估局势，并将于今晚公布临时死亡人数。 与此同时，金沙萨政府发表了一份关于X的声明，但没有具体说明伤亡人数。 声明称：“国民教育和新公民部对这场致命火灾表示深切哀悼。” “由于多人丧生，多人受伤，死亡人数仍然是临时的。部长表示哀悼，重申与家庭的团结，并下令对受影响的学校进行评估，以确保学习的连续性。” 上周末金沙萨发生了类似火灾，当地居民在婚礼宴会厅发生踩踏事故，造成人员伤亡。 作为回应，政府已下令采取严格的安全措施，并在全国范围内部署工作人员，以在公共聚集场所执行标准。

reflection.en: The news from Bukavu is heartbreaking, with children among the feared dead after a fire and stampede. In such moments, the call to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves" resonates deeply. We are reminded to advocate for the vulnerable, especially children caught in the crossfire of conflict and disaster.
reflection.zh: 布卡武传来的消息令人心碎，火灾和踩踏事件后，有儿童被认为已经丧生。在这样的时刻，“为那些不能为自己说话的人说话”的呼吁产生了深刻的共鸣。我们被提醒要为弱势群体发声，特别是那些卷入冲突和灾难中的儿童。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Digital data leeches: trading on our profiles
title.zh: 数字数据吸血鬼：交易我们的个人资料

summary.en: US tech companies are increasingly collecting, linking, and selling user information. The Grindr dating app scandal exemplifies how easily highly sensitive data can fall into the wrong hands, raising concerns about privacy and the monetization of personal details.
summary.zh: 美国科技公司越来越多地收集、关联和出售用户信息。约会应用Grindr的丑闻表明，高度敏感的数据很容易落入不法分子手中，引发了对隐私和个人信息商业化的担忧。

body.en:
US tech companies gather, link, and sell more and more information about their users. The scandal involving the dating app Grindr shows how easy it is for highly sensitive data to fall into the wrong hands.

Everyone has secrets. Things they wouldn't tell just anyone – except, perhaps, their dating app . What sort of partner they're looking for. Where they go to look for them. Their sexual preferences, maybe, or details about their health.

This information is meant to help the app find suitable matches. Selling the details on to other companies is not in the users' interest.

But this is what allegedly happened with Grindr, a dating app explicitly aimed at the LGBTQ+ community. Around 12,000 app users in Britain sued the company, which they said had shared highly sensitive personal information with advertisers — even, in some cases, a user's HIV status.

The lawsuit, filed in 2024, was settled earlier this week. Grindr has agreed to pay the claimants a total of 26 million pounds (€30 million; $35 million) – but stresses that this is not an admission of liability. Grindr continues to dispute the allegations, there has been no legal judgement.

This latest case is just one of many that raise the bigger question of what actually happens to the information we entrust to our apps on a daily basis.

For users, an app is primarily just a helpful product. But they are often supported by cloud services, analysis tools, advertising networks and other service providers. They save and transfer data, link and analyse it — often contrary to our interest.

Jan Penfrat, a digital policy expert, says that many of the big tech companies want to "make it as difficult as possible for users and regulatory authorities to understand what data is gathered on our devices by which players, and for what purpose."

Penfrat works for European Digital Rights (EDRi), a European network of NGOs and experts that campaigns to defend fundamental rights and freedoms in the digital realm.

We all know what it's like: An app, a messenger service, for example, is quickly installed, and when it asks if it has permission to use personal data, users will often just click "yes."

But the devil is in the detail. When you install WhatsApp, for example, you give it access to all the contacts in your smartphone. The phone numbers are transferred to the server — including those of people who don't use WhatsApp themselves, and who have not given permission for their contact details to be passed on.

Companies like Google then offer so-called "targeting" products based on this data.

"This means a car or clothes manufacturer can say: I'd like to address these target groups, and I want my advertising to appear in their Google search, Google Mail, or any of the...
body.zh: 美国科技公司收集、链接和出售越来越多的用户信息。涉及约会应用程序 Grindr 的丑闻表明，高度敏感的数据很容易落入坏人之手。 每个人都有秘密。他们不会告诉任何人的事情——也许除了他们的约会应用程序。他们正在寻找什么样的合作伙伴。他们去哪里寻找他们。也许是他们的性取向，或者有关他们健康状况的详细信息。 此信息旨在帮助应用程序找到合适的匹配项。将详细信息出售给其他公司不符合用户的利益。 但这就是据称在 Grindr 上发生的事情，这是一款专门针对 LGBTQ+ 群体的约会应用程序。英国约 12,000 名应用程序用户起诉了该公司，称该公司与广告商共享了高度敏感的个人信息，甚至在某些情况下还共享了用户的艾滋病毒感染状况。 这起诉讼于 2024 年提起，并于本周早些时候达成和解。 Grindr 已同意向索赔人支付总计 2600 万英镑（3000 万欧元；3500 万美元）的赔偿，但强调这并不意味着承认承担责任。 Grindr 仍在对这些指控提出异议，目前尚未有法律判决。 这个最新案例只是提出了一个更大问题的众多案例之一，即我们每天​​委托给应用程序的信息实际上发生了什么。 对于用户来说，应用程序主要只是一个有用的产品。但它们通常得到云服务、分析工具、广告网络和其他服务提供商的支持。他们保存和传输数据、链接和分析数据——通常违背我们的利益。 数字政策专家简·彭弗拉特 (Jan Penfrat) 表示，许多大型科技公司希望“让用户和监管机构尽可能难以了解哪些参与者在我们的设备上收集了哪些数据以及出于什么目的”。 Penfrat 为欧洲数字版权 (EDRi) 工作，这是一个由非政府组织和专家组成的欧洲网络，致力于捍卫数字领域的基本权利和自由。 我们都知道它是什么样的：例如，快速安装应用程序（例如消息服务），当它询问是否有权使用个人数据时，用户通常只会单击“是”。 但问题在于细节。例如，当您安装 WhatsApp 时，您就授予它访问智能手机中所有联系人的权限。电话号码会被传输到服务器，包括那些自己不使用 WhatsApp 的人以及未经允许传递其联系方式的人的电话号码。 然后，像谷歌这样的公司会根据这些数据提供所谓的“目标”产品。 “这意味着汽车或服装制造商可以说：我想针对这些目标群体，并且我希望我的广告出现在他们的 Google 搜索、Google Mail 或任何......

reflection.en: The news about Grindr's alleged data sales reveals a deep concern: the commodification of personal lives for financial gain. The Bible warns, 'The love of money is a root of all kinds of evil' (1 Timothy 6:10). When profit becomes the ultimate goal, even intimate details shared in trust can be exploited, leading to harm and betrayal.
reflection.zh: 关于Grindr涉嫌出售数据的消息揭示了一个深层担忧：将个人生活商品化以获取经济利益。《圣经》警告说：“贪财是万恶之根”（提摩太前书6:10）。当利润成为最终目标时，即使是出于信任而分享的私密细节也可能被滥用，导致伤害和背叛。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
title.zh: 也门胡塞武装据报夺取战略红海港口摩卡

summary.en: The capture of Mokha by Yemen's Houthis would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a crucial shipping route. The Houthis stated they pose no threat to international shipping but reiterated threats against Saudi Arabia, which relies on the Red Sea for oil exports.
summary.zh: 也门胡塞武装夺取摩卡港将使其更接近控制关键航道曼德海峡。胡塞武装表示不对国际航运构成威胁，但重申了对沙特阿拉伯的威胁，沙特阿拉伯依赖红海进行石油出口。

body.en:
Yemen's Houthis have seized the strategic Red Sea port city of Mokha from Saudi-backed pro-government forces, military sources and witnesses say.

Mokha's capture leaves the Iran-backed group only 75km (46 miles) away from the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the southern gateway to a trade route that links Asia and Europe.

The Houthis said they posed no threat to international shipping but reiterated their threat to target vessels from Saudi Arabia, which has relied on the Red Sea for oil exports since the US and Israel's war effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz in the Gulf.

The escalation of the conflict between the Houthis, Yemen's government and Saudi Arabia has contributed to a surge in oil prices.

Hundreds of people have reportedly been killed and thousands displaced since the Houthis launched an offensive in the south-west a week ago.

A Saudi-led coalition has also carried out air strikes on Houthi-controlled areas in western Yemen in support of the pro-government forces, and the Houthis have launched missiles and drones at cities and oil facilities in southern Saudi Arabia.

Mokha residents said Houthi fighters moved into the city after fierce clashes with pro-government forces on Wednesday night, prompting many families to flee their homes.

"The takeover came without warning. Panic spread throughout the area, forcing people to flee amid distressing scenes of injured people lying in the streets with no-one there to help them," one man told BBC Arabic's Middle East Lifeline programme.

Another man said that Houthi fighters were patrolling the streets of Mokha on Thursday, while government offices and shops were closed.

"At the moment, we don't know what Ansar Allah will do," he added, using the group's formal name. "Everyone is afraid for their safety."

Many displaced families are heading east towards the city of Aden, where Yemen's internationally recognised Presidential Leadership Council and government are based.

"We fled with our children and kept running. We have no bedding, no home, nothing with us. Everything was destroyed within an hour. They didn't even give us a chance or warn us beforehand," one woman told BBC Arabic.

"We are women with no means of defending ourselves, and we have innocent children with us."

But the group's Supreme Political Council said in a statement on Thursday that clashes had "ceased in the western coast districts after the expulsion of Saudi enemy mobilisations", according to Houthi-run Al Masirah TV.

Tarek Salah, leader of the pro-government National Resistance Forces, also said he had moved his command centre on the west coast to a "safe location".

He added that his forces had paid "a heavy price in recent days in the face of a Houthi offensive that was planned and supported by Iran".

A Yemeni military...
body.zh: 军方消息人士和目击者称，也门胡塞武装已从沙特支持的亲政府部队手中夺取了红海战略港口城市莫卡。 莫卡的捕获使伊朗支持的组织距离曼德海峡仅 75 公里（46 英里），曼德海峡是连接亚洲和欧洲的贸易路线的南大门。 胡塞武装表示，他们对国际航运不构成威胁，但重申他们的威胁是针对沙特阿拉伯的船只。自从美国和以色列的战争有效关闭了海湾的霍尔木兹海峡以来，沙特阿拉伯一直依赖红海进行石油出口。 胡塞武装、也门政府和沙特之间的冲突升级，导致油价飙升。 据报道，自胡塞武装一周前在西南部发动攻势以来，已有数百人丧生，数千人流离失所。 沙特领导的联军还对也门西部胡塞武装控制的地区进行了空袭，以支持亲政府军，胡塞武装还向沙特阿拉伯南部的城市和石油设施发射了导弹和无人机。 莫卡居民表示，周三晚上，胡塞武装分子与亲政府部队发生激烈冲突后进入该市，导致许多家庭逃离家园。 一名男子告诉 BBC 阿拉伯语中东生命线节目：“接管行动没有任何警告。恐慌在整个地区蔓延，迫使人们逃离，看到受伤的人躺在街道上，无人救助的悲惨景象。” 另一名男子表示，胡塞武装人员周四在莫卡街道巡逻，而政府办公室和商店都关闭了。 “目前，我们不知道安萨尔真主会做什么，”他补充说，使用了该组织的正式名称。 “每个人都担心自己的安全。” 许多流离失所的家庭正在向东前往亚丁市，那里是国际公认的也门总统领导委员会和政府所在地。 一名妇女告诉 BBC 阿拉伯语频道：“我们带着孩子逃离，继续奔跑。我们没有被褥，没有家，什么也没有。一小时内一切都被毁了。他们甚至没有给我们机会，也没有事先警告我们。” “我们是没有办法保护自己的女性，而且我们还有无辜的孩子。” 但据胡塞武装运营的 Al Masirah 电视台报道，该组织最高政治委员会在周四的一份声明中表示，“在沙特敌方动员被驱逐后，西海岸地区的冲突已经停止”。 亲政府的全国抵抗力量领导人塔里克·萨拉赫也表示，他已将西海岸的指挥中心迁至“安全地点”。 他补充说，他的部队“最近几天面对伊朗策划和支持的胡塞武装攻势付出了沉重代价”。 也门军方...

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict in Yemen, with the strategic capture of Mokha, illustrates the devastating and persistent nature of war. In times of such entrenched global conflict, where peace seems distant, we are reminded of the divine promise to ultimately bring an end to all warfare. May we hold onto hope for that day when weapons are silenced and peace prevails.
reflection.zh: 也门冲突的持续，以及摩卡港的战略性被占领，凸显了战争的毁灭性和持久性。在如此根深蒂固的全球冲突、和平似乎遥不可及之时，我们被提醒了雅伟终将结束一切争战的应许。愿我们怀抱希望，期待那武器被静默、和平得以彰显的日子。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: 25 years after 9/11: Al-Qaeda weakened but not gone
title.zh: 9/11事件25年后：基地组织虽受削弱但并未消失

summary.en: Twenty-five years after the 9/11 attacks, the terrorist group al-Qaeda is significantly weaker than it once was. While its central leadership has been diminished, its affiliated groups continue to be active and strong in various parts of Africa and Asia. The US has also eased sanctions on individuals like extremist...
summary.zh: 在9/11事件发生25年后，恐怖组织基地组织已不再是其曾经的全球性恐怖组织。其核心领导层虽然受到削弱，但在非洲和亚洲的分支仍然强大。美国也已解除对极端主义传教士阿卜杜拉·穆海西尼等人的制裁。

body.en:
25 years after 9/11, the terrorist group al-Qaeda is no longer the global terrorist organization it once was. Its central leadership has been weakened, but offshoots remain strong across Africa and Asia.

The extremist preacher Abdullah al-Muhaysini no longer has to worry about US sanctions. In late August 2026, the US Department of the Treasury removed the former jihadist from the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list, or SDN List . It includes individuals and organizations whose assets are frozen in the US and with whom US citizens are generally not allowed to do business.

After Syria's civil war broke out in 2011, al-Muhaysini recruited fighters and helped establish a governing structure shaped by the Nusra Front, which emerged from al-Qaeda .

His removal from the list is linked to the new US government policy on Syria: Washington also removed  the Nusra Front and Hayat Tahrir al-Sham ( HTS ) from the SDN List.

25 years after the September 11 attacks , this is a remarkable snapshot. Al-Qaeda  — which means "the base" in Arabic — has neither disappeared nor remained the same organization: Its core has weakened, but its regional branches have remained strong across parts of Africa and Asia, observers agree.

"This is largely due to the successful counterterrorism efforts following 2001," Lars Berger, professor of terrorism studies at the German Federal University of Administrative Sciences, told DW.

The military campaign in Afghanistan , along with cooperation between intelligence agencies and police, has significantly weakened the group.

"From this perspective, the September 11 attacks were a major strategic failure for al-Qaeda," Berger said.

The hoped-for radicalization of the Arab world and the overthrow of its regimes failed to materialize. About ten years after the attacks in New York and Washington , al-Qaeda's most famous figure, Osama bin Laden, was killed  in May 2011.

"The militia sought out areas where it could establish a permanent foothold, for example in parts of Africa or Yemen ," Berger said, adding that "countries with weak state structures, overwhelmed security forces and unresolved local conflicts are particularly favorable."

"Today, this is particularly true of Africa," Rüdiger Lohlker, professor emeritus of Islamic studies at the University of Vienna, notes. 

In the Sahel , Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin, or JNIM, has emerged as a powerful al-Qaeda offshoot, he said.

An analysis by the think tank Critical Threats Project uses Niger as an example to show how JNIM and the Islamic State's Sahel Province (ISSP) compete for territory, fighters and resources. In June 2026, JNIM claimed responsibility for an attack on the international airport in Niger's capital, Niamey.

body.zh: 9/11 事件发生 25 年后，恐怖组织“基地”组织不再像以前那样是全球性的恐怖组织。其中央领导地位已被削弱，但其在非洲和亚洲的分支机构依然强大。 极端主义传教士阿卜杜拉·穆海西尼不再需要担心美国的制裁。 2026 年 8 月下旬，美国财政部将这位前圣战分子从特别指定国民和封锁人员名单（SDN 名单）中删除。它包括资产在美国被冻结且美国公民通常不允许与其开展业务的个人和组织。 2011 年叙利亚内战爆发后，穆海西尼招募了战士，并帮助建立了一个由从基地组织中诞生的努斯拉阵线塑造的治理结构。 他从名单中删除与美国政府对叙利亚的新政策有关：华盛顿还将努斯拉阵线和沙姆解放组织 (HTS) 从 SDN 名单中删除。 9 月 11 日袭击事件发生 25 年后，这是一个非凡的快照。观察人士一致认为，基地组织——在阿拉伯语中的意思是“基地”——既没有消失，也没有保持原来的组织：其核心已被削弱，但其在非洲和亚洲部分地区的地区分支仍然强大。 德国联邦行政科学大学恐怖主义研究教授拉尔斯·伯杰（Lars Berger）告诉德国之声：“这主要归功于2001年之后成功的反恐努力。” 阿富汗的军事行动以及情报机构和警方之间的合作大大削弱了该组织的力量。 “从这个角度来看，9 月 11 日的袭击是基地组织的重大战略失败，”伯杰说。 人们所希望的阿拉伯世界激进化和推翻其政权的愿望未能实现。纽约和华盛顿袭击事件发生大约十年后，基地组织最著名的人物奥萨马·本·拉登于 2011 年 5 月被击毙。 伯杰说：“民兵寻找可以建立永久立足点的地区，例如非洲或也门的部分地区。”他补充说，“国家结构薄弱、安全部队不堪重负且当地冲突尚未解决的国家尤其有利。” “今天，非洲尤其如此，”维也纳大学伊斯兰研究名誉教授鲁迪格·洛尔克指出。 他说，在萨赫勒地区，穆斯林努斯拉特伊斯兰大会（Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin，简称 JNIM）已成为基地组织的一个强大分支。 智库“关键威胁项目”的分析以尼日尔为例，展示了 JNIM 与“伊斯兰国”萨赫勒省（ISSP）如何争夺领土、武装人员和资源。 2026 年 6 月，JNIM 声称对尼日尔首都尼亚美国际机场的袭击事件负责。 在...

reflection.en: Even as al-Qaeda's central command has been dismantled, the persistence of its offshoots across continents highlights the enduring challenge of extremist ideologies. The principle of overcoming evil with good, rather than mirroring its violence, remains a vital call for communities grappling with such threats.
reflection.zh: 尽管基地组织的核心指挥已被瓦解，但其在各大洲的分支依然存在，这凸显了极端主义意识形态带来的持久挑战。以善胜恶的原则，而非以暴制暴，对于应对此类威胁的社群来说，仍然是重要的呼吁。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

summary.en: The closure of Germany's Goethe-Institut branches in Russia by September 13th is causing significant disruption to Russians planning to study in Germany or engage in cultural exchange. This action stems from a diplomatic dispute between Germany and Russia, initiated by Russia's foreign ministry in response to...
summary.zh: 德国歌德学院将于9月13日前关闭在俄罗斯的所有分支机构，这给计划赴德留学或进行文化交流的俄罗斯人带来了重大影响。此举源于德国与俄罗斯之间的一场外交争端，俄罗斯外交部下令关闭文化中心，以回应德国在8月初发生的一起无人机袭击事件后对俄实施的制裁。

title.en: African Parks: when conservation becomes a question of power
title.zh: 非洲公园：当保护成为权力问题

summary.en: African Parks is dedicated to protecting wildlife across vast areas of the continent. However, the organization is facing allegations of human rights abuses by its rangers. Amidst these reports, Prince Harry is stepping down from his role on the organization's board.
summary.zh: 非洲公园致力于保护非洲大陆的广阔区域内的野生动物。然而，该组织正面临其护林员侵犯人权的指控。在这些报道中，哈里王子将辞去在该组织董事会的职务。

body.en:
African Parks is dedicated to protecting wildlife on the continent across some vast areas. But the organization faces allegations of human rights abuses by rangers. Now Prince Harry is stepping down from its board.

Prince Harry has long been a supporter of African wildlife and nature . When the British royal first became involved with African Parks in 2016, he served as a prominent figure supporting awareness on elephant conservation.

Later, the son of King Charles III became president of the organization before joining its board in 2023.

But reports indicate that in just a few weeks' time, he will step down from his position at African Parks. The NGO claims that the move is merely part of a reshuffling of its board.

But Dutch journalist and author Olivier van Beemen, who has extensively investigated the South Africa-based wildlife conservation group, believes the association between Harry and African Parks has increasingly become a burden — for both sides.

Harry's role was to mainly open doors for African Parks, van Beemen says. His fame attracted media attention and helped the NGO gain access to potential donors. But his notorious falling-out with his family increasingly failed to improve the organization's coffers and image.

At the same time, allegations of human rights abuses at African Parks made the prince's association with the organization increasingly problematic.

"I think they now see each other more as a liability," van Beemen told DW, stressing that the full story reaches far beyond a junior member of the royal family simply stepping down from a ribbon-cutting role.

According to its own figures, African Parks manages 24 protected areas in 13 African countries, covering more than 20 million hectares. By 2030, the organization aims to manage as many as 30 parks.

Its business model is known as delegated management: African governments hand over the long-term management of protected areas to the group.

The land formally remains state-owned. But the organization takes on wide-ranging responsibilities, including conservation , infrastructure, tourism and anti-poaching operations.

For African governments, this model offers a major advantage: African Parks brings international funding, expertise and personnel to protected areas that many states would otherwise struggle to manage on their own.

In order to achieve its objectives on the ground, African Parks employs a host of armed rangers across the continent, who are allowed to use indelicate methods if and when needed; in some cases, its influence even extends to managing border controls.

"They take over the state's monopoly on the use of force within the park," says van Beemen, adding that some critics of the NGO...
body.zh: 非洲公园致力于保护非洲大陆一些广阔地区的野生动物。但该组织面临护林员侵犯人权的指控。现在，哈里王子将从董事会辞职。 哈里王子长期以来一直是非洲野生动物和自然的支持者。当英国王室于 2016 年首次参与非洲公园时，他是支持大象保护意识的杰出人物。 后来，国王查理三世的儿子成为该组织的主席，并于 2023 年加入其董事会。 但有报道称，几周后，他将辞去非洲公园的职务。该非政府组织声称此举只是其董事会改组的一部分。 但荷兰记者兼作家奥利维尔·范·比曼（Olivier van Beemen）对南非野生动物保护组织进行了广泛调查，他认为哈利和非洲公园之间的联系已经日益成为双方的负担。 范比门说，哈里的作用主要是为非洲公园打开大门。他的名气引起了媒体的关注，并帮助该非政府组织接触到潜在的捐助者。但他与家人臭名昭著的争吵越来越未能改善该组织的资金和形象。 与此同时，对非洲公园侵犯人权的指控使王子与该组织的关系变得越来越成问题。 范比门告诉德国之声：“我认为他们现在更多地将彼此视为一种负担。”他强调，整个故事远远超出了王室初级成员简单地辞去剪彩角色的范围。 根据其自己的数据，非洲公园管理着 13 个非洲国家的 24 个保护区，面积超过 2000 万公顷。到 2030 年，该组织的目标是管理多达 30 个公园。 其商业模式被称为委托管理：非洲各国政府将保护区的长期管理权交给该集团。 该土地正式仍为国有。但该组织承担广泛的责任，包括保护、基础设施、旅游和反偷猎行动。 对于非洲政府来说，这种模式提供了一个主要优势：非洲公园为保护区带来了国际资金、专业知识和人员，否则许多国家将难以自行管理这些保护区。 为了实现其实地目标，非洲公园在整个非洲大陆雇用了大批武装护林员，他们可以在需要时使用不雅的方法；在某些情况下，其影响力甚至延伸到边境管制管理。 范比门说：“他们接管了国家在公园内使用武力的垄断权。”他补充说，一些对该非政府组织的批评......

reflection.en: The news about African Parks raises concerns about the potential for power imbalances within conservation efforts, leading to allegations of human rights abuses. This situation calls to mind the biblical imperative to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring that the pursuit of protecting nature does not come at the cost of human dignity....
reflection.zh: 关于非洲公园的新闻引发了对保护工作中潜在权力失衡的担忧，导致了侵犯人权的指控。这种情况让人想起圣经中为那些不能为自己说话的人说话的诫命，确保保护自然的追求不会以牺牲人的尊严为代价。 随着哈里王子辞去董事会职务，这突显了在所有组织中，尤其是在那些肩负重任的组织中，问责制和道德操守的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How ancient teeth are changing what we know about early drug use
title.zh: 古代牙齿如何改变我们对早期药物使用的认知

summary.en: Scientists suggest that ancient humans may have utilized a nut with psychoactive properties for pain relief, based on new research.
summary.zh: 科学家根据新的研究表明，古代人类可能曾使用一种具有精神活性特性的坚果来缓解疼痛。

body.en:
A study of the teeth of ancient hunter-gatherers shows they sucked on betel nuts, evidence that humans used mind-altering drugs much earlier than previously thought, scientists say.

The Griffith University study, led by Professor Adam Brumm, examined teeth from two skeletons found on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi.

One dated from 16,000 to 25,000 years ago and the other from 6,300 to 7,600 years ago.

Their teeth showed unusual deep and rounded grooves that archaeologists established were caused by previously unknown drug-use behaviour — the habitual sucking of betel nuts, possibly for pain relief.

The betel or areca nut is a palm seed from Southeast Asia and is the fourth most commonly used psychoactive substance in the world, behind alcohol, caffeine and nicotine.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It is mixed with slaked lime powder and chewed to boost its psychoactive properties and create a powerful stimulant.

But adding lime came after the time of the ancient hunter-gatherers, with Brumm saying it's thought they sucked betel nuts for pain relief.

"We think this was a longstanding cultural tradition of drug use that predated the invention of betel nut chewing as we know it today," he told the Australian Associated Press.

"We think this is how humans discovered the mind-altering properties of this particular type of drug."

It was the earliest evidence of the deliberate consumption of a psychoactive plant product but also the earliest evidence of habitual drug use, Brumm said.

Continuous betel-nut sucking wore down the teeth of ancient users, leading to cavities and intense pain, prompting more use of the nut for pain relief in an addictive cycle, he said.

"We can't exclude that they were getting a psychoactive hit but ... we don't think they were getting high on sucking betel nut."

Over time, ancient people discovered they could make a more potent stimulant if they chewed betel nut mixed with slaked lime, inducing mild euphoria and heightened alertness.

It had been thought the world's first traditions of psychoactive drug use arose after the Neolithic advent of farming, beginning with fermented barley beer about 13,000 years ago in what is now Israel.

The study's findings suggest habitual psychoactive substance use, and its associated health costs, were already present among hunter-gatherers tens of thousands of years before agriculture, Brumm said.

body.zh: 科学家表示，对古代狩猎采集者牙齿的研究表明，他们吸食槟榔，这证明人类使用改变精神药物的时间比之前想象的要早得多。 格里菲斯大学的研究由亚当·布鲁姆教授领导，检查了在印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛发现的两具骨骼中的牙齿。 一个可以追溯到 16,000 至 25,000 年前，另一个可以追溯到 6,300 至 7,600 年前。 他们的牙齿显示出不寻常的深而圆形的凹槽，考古学家确定这些凹槽是由以前未知的吸毒行为引起的——习惯性吮吸槟榔，可能是为了缓解疼痛。 槟榔或槟榔是来自东南亚的棕榈种子，是世界上第四大最常用的精神活性物质，仅次于酒精、咖啡因和尼古丁。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 将其与熟石灰粉混合并咀嚼可增强其精神活性并产生强大的兴奋剂。 但添加石灰是在古代狩猎采集时代之后出现的，布鲁姆说，人们认为他们吸槟榔是为了缓解疼痛。 “我们认为这是一种长期存在的吸毒文化传统，早于我们今天所知的咀嚼槟榔的发明，”他告诉澳大利亚美联社。 “我们认为这就是人类发现这种特殊药物的改变精神特性的方式。” 布鲁姆说，这是故意食用精神活性植物产品的最早证据，也是习惯性吸毒的最早证据。 他说，连续吸食槟榔会磨损古代使用者的牙齿，导致蛀牙和剧烈疼痛，促使人们更多地使用槟榔来缓解疼痛，形成成瘾循环。 “我们不能排除他们受到了精神上的打击，但是……我们不认为他们是因为吸食槟榔而兴奋的穴居人。” 随着时间的推移，古人发现，如果咀嚼槟榔和熟石灰混合，可以产生一种更有效的兴奋剂，引起轻微的欣快感和高度的警觉性。 人们认为，世界上第一个使用精神药物的传统是在新石器时代农业出现之后出现的，始于大约 13,000 年前在现在的以色列的发酵大麦啤酒。 布鲁姆说，这项研究的结果表明，在农业出现之前数万年，狩猎采集者就已经存在习惯性精神活性物质的使用及其相关的健康成本。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

body.en: French company Puy du Fou is planning a £600m history-themed park in Oxfordshire. A Guardian investigation has found the company continued working with associates of Konstantin Malofeyev, a pro-Kremlin oligarch under sanctions, on plans for a theme park in Russian-occupied Crimea for longer than it had previously disclosed, and later explored projects in Iran and China. Business reporter Rob Davies explains his findings, including documents that raise questions about whether Puy du Fou’s activities tested the limits of EU sanctions imposed after Russia’s 2014 annexation of Crimea. He also examines the far-right politics associated with Puy du Fou’s founder, Philippe de Villiers, and asks whether the company is a suitable choice to tell Britain’s national story Kremlin connections: the Russia links to a £600m UK theme park Continue reading...

The pursuit of profit should not overshadow the...

title.en: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
title.zh: 中国东部货船火灾致二十五人死亡

summary.en: Twenty-five people have died after a fire broke out on a cargo ship docked in eastern China. Of the 42 individuals on board, 17 were rescued, with five requiring hospitalization.
summary.zh: 中国东部一艘货船发生火灾，造成二十五人死亡。船上共有四十二人，其中十七人获救，五人需住院治疗。

body.en:
Twenty-five people have been killed in a fire on a foreign-flagged cargo ship docked at a port in eastern China, according to Chinese state broadcaster CCTV.

Of the 42 people on board, 17 were were evacuated of which five are in hospital in stable condition, CCTV reports.

The vessel was undergoing maintenance at a shipyard in the city of Qingdao when the blaze erupted at around 11:15 local time (03:15 GMT). It was put out just over three hours later, according to CCTV.

Photos released by state media showed the vessel to be the Ocean Melody, a 190m (623ft) long Liberia-flagged carrier which arrived in Qingdao on 31 August, according to tracking site MarineTraffic.

It is unclear what caused the fire. An eyewitness told the AFP news agency there was thick smoke rising from the ship, but he heard no explosion.

The country's leader Xi Jinping earlier called for "all-out" search and rescue efforts while Premier Li Qiang stressed the need to "prevent secondary disasters".

The fire comes nearly a month after a shipyard explosion in the south-eastern Chinese province of Fujian killed a rescue worker and injured 12 others.
body.zh: 据中国国家电视台中央电视台报道，一艘停泊在中国东部港口的悬挂外国国旗的货船发生火灾，造成 25 人死亡。 据央视报道，机上42人中，17人已被疏散，其中5人在医院，情况稳定。 当地时间 11 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 03 点 15 分）左右起火时，该船正在青岛市的一家造船厂进行维护。据中央电视台报道，仅三个多小时后，该消息就被发布了。 据跟踪网站 MarineTraffic 报道，官方媒体发布的照片​​显示，这艘船是 Ocean Melody 号，这是一艘长 190m（623 英尺）、悬挂利比里亚国旗的运输船，于 8 月 31 日抵达青岛。 目前尚不清楚起火原因。一名目击者告诉法新社，船上冒出浓烟，但他没有听到爆炸声。 中国领导人习近平早些时候呼吁“全力以赴”开展搜救工作，而总理李强则强调需要“防止次生灾害”。 火灾发生近一个月前，中国东南部福建省发生造船厂爆炸，造成一名救援人员死亡、十二人受伤。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of 25 lives in the Qingdao port fire is a stark reminder of the fragility of life and the deep sorrow that such events bring. In a world marked by suffering and death, we hold onto the promise of a future where such pain will cease.
reflection.zh: 青岛港货船火灾造成25人死亡的悲剧，令人痛心地认识到生命的脆弱和事件带来的深切悲伤。在这个充满苦难和死亡的世界里，我们怀抱一个应许，那时的痛苦将不再有。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

summary.en: At least 25 people were killed and five remain missing after a fire on a cargo vessel receiving repairs at a shipyard in the northeastern Chinese port city of Qingdao, state media reported on Thursday. The vessel, identified as the "Ocean Melody," caught fire around 11:15 a.m. local time and the blaze was extinguished...
summary.zh: 据国家媒体周四报道，在中国东北部港口城市青岛的一家造船厂，一艘正在接受维修的货船发生火灾，造成至少25人死亡，另有5人失踪。该船被确认为“海洋旋律”号，于当地时间上午11:15左右起火，大火于下午2:30左右被扑灭。

body.zh: 一艘货船在青岛港起火，造成至少五人失踪。原因尚不清楚。 据官方媒体周四报道，中国东北港口城市青岛一家造船厂一艘正在维修的货船发生火灾，造成至少 25 人死亡，5 人失踪。 据国家电视台中央电视台报道，这艘载有 42 人的船只于当地时间上午 11 点 15 分左右起火，并于下午 2 点 30 分左右被扑灭。 （世界标准时间 0630）。” 据官方通讯社新华社报道，这艘船被确定为长 190 米（623 英尺）的散货船“Ocean Melody”，悬挂利比里亚国旗。 新华社补充说，中国国家主席习近平发布了开展搜救任务的“重要指示”，同时还呼吁对可能对此次事件负责的任何人进行调查。 习近平表示，“各地区、各有关部门要深刻汲取此次事件教训，彻查整顿各类火灾隐患”。 该船当时正在青岛北海造船有限公司进行维修，该公司隶属于中国船舶工业集团公司（CSSC），是世界上最大的造船厂之一。

reflection.en: The news from Qingdao is heartbreaking, detailing the loss of life in a sudden, devastating fire. In moments of profound tragedy, when grief feels overwhelming, we hold onto the promise that Yahweh will one day wipe away every tear. Until that day, may comfort be found in shared sorrow and the hope of ultimate restoration.
reflection.zh: 青岛传来的消息令人心碎，详细描述了一场突如其来的毁灭性火灾造成的生命损失。在如此深切的悲剧中，当悲伤似乎难以承受时，我们紧握着雅伟终将擦去一切眼泪的应许。直到那一天，愿在共同的哀伤和最终复原的盼望中找到安慰。

verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Call in China to end English's core status sparks debate
title.zh: 中国结束英语核心地位的呼吁引发辩论

summary.en: A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI. The debate highlights the tension between traditional academic priorities and the perceived needs of a rapidly evolving, technologically advanced society.
summary.zh: 在中国，一项旨在降低英语在中国学校核心地位的呼吁，正引发关于英语对学生、职业以及人工智能时代中国全球竞争力的价值的讨论。这场辩论凸显了传统学术优先事项与一个快速发展、技术先进的社会之需求之间的紧张关系。

body.en:
A call to downgrade English in Chinese schools is fueling discussion over its value for students, careers and China's global competitiveness in the age of AI.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent advocate for English as a required subject is Hu Xijin,...
body.zh: 降低中国学校英语等级的呼声引发了关于人工智能时代英语对学生、职业和中国全球竞争力价值的讨论。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。将英语作为必修科目的一位著名倡导者是胡锡进……

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge, particularly in fields like AI, presents both opportunities and challenges. As China debates the role of English in its education system, it grapples with how best to equip its students for a future where information and communication are constantly evolving. This reflects Daniel's prophecy of knowledge increasing,...
reflection.zh: 知识的快速增长，尤其是在人工智能等领域，既带来了机遇也带来了挑战。中国在辩论英语在其教育体系中的作用时，正努力思考如何最好地为学生在一个信息和沟通不断发展的未来做好准备。这呼应了但以理关于知识增长的预言，敦促我们在获取信息的同时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How Mao Zedong's legacy still shapes China 50 years on
title.zh: 毛泽东的遗产如何至今仍在塑造中国

summary.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China has undergone significant transformation. However, his legacy persists, influencing current leadership under Xi Jinping and fueling a resurgence of Maoist nostalgia among younger generations.
summary.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。然而，他的遗产依然存在，影响着习近平领导下的当今政权，并在年轻一代中引发了对毛泽东时代的新怀旧潮。

body.en:
China has transformed since Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago. But his legacy endures — from Xi Jinping's rule to a new wave of Mao nostalgia among young Chinese.

On September 9, 1976, Mao Zedong died. The revolutionary leader who led the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to power and founded the People's Republic of China left behind a profoundly contradictory historical legacy.

He shaped the narratives of revolution, nation-building and national independence, but also left behind immense social trauma as a result of successive political campaigns and persecutions.

When Mao died, China was still a poor and relatively isolated communist state. Today, it is the world's second-largest economy, deeply embedded in the supply and value chains of global capitalism, with a vast private sector, a large urban middle class and a highly digitalized society. 

Zhang Lun, a professor at Cergy-Paris University, said Mao left behind four major political legacies: the authoritarian and highly centralized political system; a model of governance that relies on revolution and political campaigns to solve social problems; populist tendencies marked by anti-elitism and anti-rationalism; and utopian visions of egalitarianism and moralism.

From the perspective of political legacies, Zhang told DW, the most fundamental change in China over the past five decades has been "de-Maoization" — while its greatest challenge has been that this process was never fully completed.

Mao's name remains written into the CCP's constitution, while his thought remains part of China's official ideology and his portrait still hangs in Beijing's Tiananmen Square.

Mao helped forge the Chinese Communist Party, and his insistence on the party's supremacy over the state and society has remained a fundamental principle throughout the decades, said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt, professor at the University of Zurich.

Veteran journalist and political commentator Chang Ping agrees, adding that what has truly endured is the institutional core of the principle that "the party leads everything," serving a state vision of being able to "concentrate resources to accomplish major tasks." 

The CCP, he said, can pursue such objectives "at all costs" — meaning the interests of ordinary people can be sacrificed to the maximum extent necessary to preserve the regime. 

Under current leader Xi Jinping , a number of political concepts and methods of governance associated with the Mao era — such as ideological unity and the spirit of "struggle" — have again attracted attention.

Xi's actions such as abolishing the presidential term limits, strengthening his personal authority and the incorporation of his political...
body.zh: 毛泽东逝世50年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。但他的遗产依然存在——从习近平的统治到中国年轻人新一轮的毛泽东怀旧浪潮。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强他的个人权威以及纳入他的政治...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago marked a turning point for China, yet his ideological and political shadow continues to shape the nation. This enduring influence, from state narratives to popular nostalgia, speaks to the profound and often complex impact of historical figures. The story prompts reflection on how legacies, whether positive or negative, can...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年标志着中国的一个转折点，但他的意识形态和政治影响至今仍在塑造着这个国家。这种从国家叙事到大众怀旧的持久影响，体现了历史人物深刻而复杂的作用。这个故事促使我们反思，无论正面还是负面，遗产如何能够持续并塑造现在，并提醒我们，不受约束的权力和野心可能带来长远甚至意想不到的后果。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Death of the auction? Sellers move to private sales in softening market
title.zh: 拍卖的终结？卖家转向私人销售以应对市场降温

summary.en: Property sellers are increasingly moving away from the traditional auction in response to a softening housing market, new data from Domain suggests, with experts arguing that Australia has firmly entered a "buyer's market".
summary.zh: 根据Domain的最新数据，由于住房市场趋于疲软，房地产卖家正越来越多地放弃传统的拍卖方式，专家认为澳大利亚已明确进入“买方市场”。

body.en:
Property sellers are increasingly moving away from the traditional auction in response to a softening housing market, new data from Domain suggests, with experts arguing that Australia has firmly entered a "buyer's market".

The online property platform has found a sharp rise in listings initially slated for auction being converted to private treaty in capital cities. Across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Canberra, the average proportion sales that are auctions has more than doubled from 29.6 per cent in February to 60.8 per cent in July.

Listings starting as private treaty also increased at the same time, highlighting a substantial move away from reliance on auction-day results as sellers seek the best price for their asset.

Domain's chief of economics and research, Nicola Powell, told SBS News that this shift in seller behaviour reflects the softening market conditions "unravelling across the nation".

"Many sellers are testing the market and realising that there just isn't that buyer depth there anymore," she said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

After major post-pandemic growth and following decades of steady increases, the Australian property market has seen a broad downturn over winter .

Data from property analyst Cotality shows that, while Sydney and Melbourne began to slow at the start of the year, national house price values peaked in March and have declined 3.6 per cent since.

Powell argued spring will likely be slower than usual, with Domain predicting property prices will continue to fall through the rest of the year.

"I think what we're going to see from buyers is they are going to want to get that greater value for money," she said.

The second quarter of 2026 saw the first sustained decline in national housing stock value since 2022, with Australian Bureau of Statistics figures showing a 0.3 per cent drop or $34.1 billion.

Shannan Whitney, co-founder of prominent Sydney property group BresicWhitney, told SBS News that shying away from auction sales could be the wrong move for sellers.

"Pricing tends to be more in line with where the market needs to be in an auction process than it does in a for sale process," he said.

"I think more vendors will be more comfortable with auction in Sydney over the next three or four months, but it just takes a little bit of time for everyone to work through the cycle."

Whitney expects the property cycle is now through its "first third" after months of price adjustments. It's "natural", he said, for sellers to want to retreat into non-auction sales where they feel safer or more in control during such a period, which he believes is now levelling off in Sydney.

body.zh: Domain 的新数据显示，为了应对房地产市场疲软的情况，房地产卖家越来越多地放弃传统拍卖，专家认为澳大利亚已经坚定地进入了“买方市场”。 该在线房地产平台发现，在首府城市，最初计划拍卖并转换为私人协议的房源数量急剧增加。在悉尼、墨尔本、布里斯班、阿德莱德和堪培拉，拍卖销售的平均比例增加了一倍多，从 2 月份的 29.6% 增至 7 月份的 60.8%。 同时，以私人协议开始的挂牌数量也有所增加，这突显出随着卖家寻求其资产的最佳价格，人们不再依赖拍卖日结果。 Domain 经济和研究主管尼古拉·鲍威尔 (Nicola Powell) 告诉 SBS 新闻，卖家行为的这种转变反映了“全国范围内”的市场状况疲软。 “许多卖家正在测试市场，并意识到那里不再有买家深度，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在大流行后的大幅增长和数十年的稳定增长之后，澳大利亚房地产市场在冬季出现了广泛的低迷。 房地产分析师 Cotality 的数据显示，虽然悉尼和墨尔本的房价在年初开始放缓，但全国房价在 3 月份达到顶峰，此后已下跌 3.6%。 鲍威尔认为，春季可能会比平常慢，Domain 预测今年剩余时间房地产价格将继续下跌。 “我认为我们将从买家那里看到的是，他们会希望获得更高的性价比，”她说。 2026 年第二季度，全国住房存量价值自 2022 年以来首次持续下降，澳大利亚统计局数据显示，下降 0.3%，即 341 亿澳元。 悉尼著名房地产集团 BresicWhitney 的联合创始人 Shannan Whitney 告诉 SBS 新闻，对于卖家来说，回避拍卖可能是错误的举动。 他说：“拍卖过程中的定价往往比出售过程中的市场需要更符合市场需要。” “我认为未来三四个月内，更多的卖家会对悉尼的拍卖感到更加满意，但每个人都需要一点时间来完成这个周期。” 惠特尼预计，经过数月的价格调整后，房地产周期现已进入“前三分之一”。他说，对于卖家来说，希望退回到非拍卖销售是“自然的”，因为在这段时期他们感觉更安全或更有控制力，他认为悉尼的这种情况现在已经趋于平稳。 “卖家真的...

reflection.en: As market conditions shift, property sellers in Australia are adapting their strategies, moving from auctions to private sales. This change reflects a need to navigate uncertainty and seek favorable outcomes in a cooling economy. The principle of committing one's plans and work to God offers a framework for seeking wisdom and blessing in such endeavors,...
reflection.zh: 随着市场状况的变化，澳大利亚的房地产卖家正在调整他们的策略，从拍卖转向私人销售。这种转变反映了在经济降温的情况下，需要应对不确定性并寻求有利的结果。将自己的计划和工作交托给雅伟的原则，为在这样的事业中寻求智慧和祝福提供了一个框架，即使前方的道路不清晰，也要相信祂会指引我们的脚步。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

title.en: Lured in by Albo ‘slur’, News24 misses the joke and mistakes comedy skit for real news report | Weekly Beast

summary.en: A comedian stated he did not anticipate the Murdoch network to be 'as gullible and digitally illiterate as their target audience.' The story also notes Karl Stefanovic falling silent. News24's presenter James Macpherson mistakenly presented a satirical video as a genuine Seven News segment, failing to recognize the...
summary.zh: 一位喜剧演员表示，他没想到默多克网络会“像他们的目标受众一样容易上当和在数字方面文盲”。故事还提到卡尔·斯特凡诺维奇保持沉默。News24的主持人詹姆斯·麦克弗森错误地将一段讽刺视频当作七号新闻的真实片段播出，未能识别出其中的幽默，并将其误认为是真实新闻。

body.en: Comedian says he didn’t expect Murdoch network to be ‘as gullible and digitally illiterate as their target audience’. Plus: Karl Stefanovic falls silent There’s nothing worse than being left out of a joke. At News24, though, they didn’t get it in the first place. The presenter James Macpherson kicked an own goal this week, presenting a satirical video as an authentic Seven News segment while hosting The Bolt Report. The video was created by the sports comedy group Kick it Forward, joking that one of the members of the group, Josh Garlepp, had quit social media after copping abuse for posting about Fremantle’s finals loss on X.
