title.en: Boy developed "toasted skin" condition from using a laptop every day
title.zh: 男孩因每天使用笔记本电脑而患上“烤肤”症

summary.en: Laptops typically do not reach temperatures high enough to cause burns, but they can still be physically harmful.
summary.zh: 笔记本电脑通常不会达到足以灼伤的温度，但它们仍然可能对身体造成伤害。

body.en: Fears that modern electronic devices may harm children are nothing new. Gadgets with screens of any size have long been allegedly melting, rotting, and/or corrupting the brains of youths for decades. However, a medical case report published this week offers a new and alarming way our digital doodads may cause physical harm. In BMJ Case Reports , two UK doctors, Mara Znagoveanu and Edward Artley, report the case of a boy who came to an emergency department with alarming marks on his abdomen. The marks were described as being in a patch about 15 centimeters (six inches) wide, made of flat, reddish-brown "interlacing lines forming irregular circles and a lace-like morphology." A picture of the marks is here . Mysterious marks The boy, whom they described only as being in "mid-childhood," was not in any pain, and the rash was not warm to the touch or tender. He and his parents said they couldn't think of any recent injuries or trauma that might explain the marks. He was otherwise healthy, hadn't recently been ill, and had no systemic symptoms, such as fever or fatigue. Everything about the boy's health, growth, and medical history looked normal. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 对现代电子设备可能伤害儿童的担忧并不是什么新鲜事。据称，几十年来，具有任何尺寸屏幕的小玩意一直在融化、腐烂和/或腐蚀年轻人的大脑。然而，本周发布的一份医疗案例报告提供了一种新的、令人震惊的方式，我们的数字小玩意可能会造成身体伤害。在《BMJ 病例报告》中，两位英国医生 Mara Znagoveanu 和 Edward Artley 报告了一名男孩的病例，该男孩的腹部出现令人震惊的痕迹，来到急诊室。这些痕迹被描述为宽约 15 厘米（六英寸）的斑块，由平坦的红棕色“交错线形成不规则的圆圈和花边状形态”组成。标记的图片在这里。神秘痕迹 这个男孩，他们只描述为“童年中期”，没有任何疼痛，皮疹摸起来不温暖也不柔软。他和他的父母说，他们想不出最近有什么受伤或创伤可以解释这些痕迹。他其他方面都很健康，最近没有生病，也没有发烧或疲劳等全身症状。男孩的健康、生长发育和病史一切看起来都很正常。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This medical report details a boy's skin condition, 'toasted skin syndrome,' caused by daily laptop use. It serves as a reminder that even seemingly benign technology can have unintended physical consequences. Psalm 139:14 marvels, 'I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.' This reminds us of...
reflection.zh: 这篇医学报告详细描述了一名男孩因每天使用笔记本电脑而患上“烤肤综合征”的皮肤病。这提醒我们，即使是看似无害的技术也可能带来意想不到的身体后果。 诗篇139:14惊叹道：“我要称谢你，因我被造，奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我深知的。”这提醒我们身体精妙的设计，以及它可能以我们未曾预料到的方式受到环境和习惯的影响。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: More Anthropic researchers warn of AI’s perils as Musk terms fears a ‘psyop’
title.zh: 更多Anthropic研究人员警告人工智能的危险，马斯克称担忧是‘心理战’

summary.en: Insiders at the firm fear that technological advancement could lead to human extinction, while others dismiss these concerns as a 'setup.' Following a former Anthropic researcher's apocalyptic declaration about artificial intelligence, more researchers and staff members at the AI startup have publicly agreed and...
summary.zh: 公司内部人士担心技术进步可能导致人类灭绝，而其他人则称担忧是‘设局’。在一位前Anthropic研究员就人工智能发表末日论声明一天后，更多该AI初创公司的研究人员和员工公开表示赞同，并发布了他们自己的严峻警告。埃隆·马斯克和其他X（前身为Twitter）上的保守派人士则将这些担忧称为‘设局’和‘心理战’。

body.en: Insiders at the firm fear tech’s advancement could cause human extinction while others are calling it a ‘setup’ A day after a former researcher at Anthropic made an apocalyptic declaration about artificial intelligence, more researchers and staff members at the AI startup publicly agreed with him and posted their own dire warnings. In response, Elon Musk and other conservative figures on X, formerly Twitter, called the chorus of concerns a “setup” and a “psyop”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司内部人士担心科技的进步可能会导致人类灭绝，而其他人则称其为“圈套”。在 Anthropic 的一位前研究员发表有关人工智能的世界末日声明后的第二天，这家人工智能初创公司的更多研究人员和工作人员公开同意他的观点，并发布了自己的可怕警告。作为回应，埃隆·马斯克和 X（前身为 Twitter）上的其他保守派人士将这种担忧称为“圈套”和“心理战”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence raises profound questions about humanity's trajectory. When the creators themselves voice fears of existential threats, it echoes the ancient story of Babel, where unchecked ambition and technological prowess led to confusion. This moment calls for humility and wisdom, seeking to align our creations with the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展引发了关于人类发展轨迹的深刻问题。当创造者本身就表达了对生存威胁的担忧时，这呼应了古老的巴别塔故事，当时不受约束的野心和技术实力导致了混乱。这一时刻呼唤谦卑和智慧，寻求将我们的创造物与所有人的福祉结合起来，而不是在不顾后果的情况下追求权力。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: LinkedIn beats "BrowserGate" lawsuits over scanning users' Chrome extensions
title.zh: 领英公司在关于扫描用户Chrome扩展程序的“浏览器门”诉讼中胜诉

summary.en: LinkedIn has successfully had two lawsuits dismissed that accused the company of scanning users' browser extensions. A judge ruled that the plaintiffs did not adequately allege that they had standing to sue, as they did not claim their extensions conveyed private information to LinkedIn.
summary.zh: 领英公司成功驳回了两起指控其扫描用户浏览器扩展程序的诉讼。一位法官裁定，原告未能充分证明他们有权提起诉讼，因为他们没有声称自己的扩展程序向领英传输了私人信息。

body.en: LinkedIn beat two lawsuits over its practice of scanning users’ browser extensions, with a judge granting the Microsoft subsidiary's motion to dismiss the cases. The users who sued LinkedIn failed to adequately allege that they have standing to sue because neither asserted that they "had browser extensions installed that conveyed private information to LinkedIn," ruled Judge Vince Chhabria in US District Court for the Northern District of California. In his ruling on Tuesday, Chhabria gave the plaintiffs leave to amend their complaints but said he doubts they can make a plausible case. "Given LinkedIn’s further arguments that users voluntarily download browser extensions, which by their nature intentionally expose data to websites, it seems unlikely that the plaintiffs will ever be able to allege a privacy violation, much less prevail at the end of the day," Chhabria wrote. California residents Nicholas Farrell and Jeff Ganan separately filed class actions against LinkedIn in April, seeking to represent themselves and other LinkedIn users. Ganan's attorney, J.R. Howell, said he is evaluating whether to bring the claims in a California state court, which has different requirements on standing, or to appeal the US district court ruling in the US Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Read full article Comments
body.zh: LinkedIn 因其扫描用户浏览器扩展程序的行为而击败了两起诉讼，法官批准了微软子公司驳回案件的动议。美国加利福尼亚州北区地方法院法官文斯·查布里亚 (Vince Chhabria) 裁定，起诉 LinkedIn 的用户未能充分声称他们有资格提起诉讼，因为他们都没有声称自己“安装了向 LinkedIn 传送私人信息的浏览器扩展”。在周二的裁决中，查布里亚允许原告修改他们的申诉，但他表示他怀疑他们能否提出一个可信的案子。查布里亚写道：“鉴于 LinkedIn 进一步提出用户自愿下载浏览器扩展的论点，这些扩展本质上是有意向网站公开数据，原告似乎不太可能指控侵犯隐私，更不用说最终获胜了。”加州居民尼古拉斯·法雷尔 (Nicholas Farrell) 和杰夫·加南 (Jeff Ganan) 于 4 月份分别对 LinkedIn 提起集体诉讼，寻求代表自己和其他 LinkedIn 用户。加南的律师 J.R. 豪厄尔 (J.R. Howell) 表示，他正在评估是否向对诉讼资格有不同要求的加利福尼亚州法院提起诉讼，或者向美国第九巡回上诉法院对美国地方法院的裁决提出上诉。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In a world awash with data, the question of privacy is paramount. This ruling highlights the need for clear allegations of harm, reminding us that true understanding and justice require careful discernment and evidence, not just the assertion of potential misuse. As Proverbs 15:15 says, "The discerning heart seeks knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks...
reflection.zh: 在这个充斥着数据的世界里，隐私问题至关重要。这项裁决强调了提出明确损害指控的必要性，提醒我们真正的理解和正义需要仔细辨别和证据，而不仅仅是断言潜在的滥用。《箴言》15:15说：“通达人的心求知识，智慧人的耳寻求知识。”

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Europe will go it alone on Venus mission after NASA yanks radar instrument
title.zh: 欧洲在NASA退出雷达仪器后将独自执行金星任务

summary.en: Europe is forging ahead with its Envision mission to Venus, developing its own radar instrument after NASA withdrew its commitment to provide one. This independent approach will allow the European Space Agency to map Venus's surface with higher resolution than previous missions.
summary.zh: 在NASA退出提供关键雷达仪器后，欧洲正推进其金星探测任务“Envision”，并自行开发雷达仪器。这种独立的方式将使欧洲空间局能够以前所未有的高分辨率绘制金星表面地图。

body.en: The European Space Agency is moving "full steam ahead" with development of a robotic mission to Venus after NASA officials determined they were unlikely to fulfill a commitment to provide a US-built radar instrument for the spacecraft, the mission's project scientist said. The European orbiter, named Envision, will map the Venusian surface at 10 times higher resolution than the last radar mission sent to Venus by NASA in the 1990s. The planet is enshrouded in a blanket of thick clouds of sulfuric acid, rendering its mysterious surface unseen by optical cameras in orbit. Radar is the most effective way to penetrate the clouds of Venus to reveal the terrain below, and scientists will use Envision to look for signs of active volcanism. NASA and ESA signed a memorandum of understanding in 2024 outlining their partnership on Envision. NASA agreed to supply a US-made synthetic aperture radar instrument, Envision's primary means of mapping the surface of Venus, along with providing tracking and communications support through NASA's Deep Space Network. In exchange, ESA would include US researchers on Envision's science team. Europe would build the Envision spacecraft and the rest of its science instruments and provide the launch on an Ariane 6 rocket. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 该任务的项目科学家表示，在美国宇航局官员确定他们不太可能履行为航天器提供美国制造的雷达仪器的承诺后，欧洲航天局正在“全力推进”金星机器人任务的开发。名为 Envision 的欧洲轨道飞行器将以比 20 世纪 90 年代 NASA 发送到金星的最后一次雷达任务高 10 倍的分辨率绘制金星表面地图。这颗行星笼罩在一层厚厚的硫酸云中，轨道上的光学相机无法看到它神秘的表面。雷达是穿透金星云层以揭示金星下方地形的最有效方法，科学家将使用“远景”来寻找活跃火山活动的迹象。 NASA 和 ESA 于 2024 年签署了一份谅解备忘录，概述了双方在 Envision 上的合作伙伴关系。美国宇航局同意提供美国制造的合成孔径雷达仪器，这是远景公司绘制金星表面地图的主要手段，并通过美国宇航局的深空网络提供跟踪和通信支持。作为交换，欧空局将让美国研究人员加入远景科技的科学团队。欧洲将建造远景航天器及其其余科学仪器，并使用阿丽亚娜 6 号火箭进行发射。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Humanity's drive to explore and understand the cosmos is a powerful impulse, often leading to ambitious, collaborative projects. When partnerships falter, as with the Envision mission losing NASA's radar instrument, the drive can shift towards independent or even competitive endeavors. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where a unified human ambition,...
reflection.zh: 人类探索和理解宇宙的冲动是强大的，常常促成宏伟的合作项目。当合作破裂时，就像“Envision”任务失去了NASA的雷达仪器一样，这种冲动可能会转向独立甚至竞争性的努力。这让人想起古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类统一的雄心壮志，尽管目标是触及天堂，但最终却被分散了。愿我们的科学探索永远伴随着谦卑，并认识到我们的局限性。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Android can now securely migrate your logins between password managers
title.zh: Android 现在可以安全地在密码管理器之间迁移您的登录信息

summary.en: App support is slim right now, but Google says more are coming. As longer, more complex passwords have become a necessity, remembering all those strings of numbers, letters, and special characters has become nearly impossible. Password managers can solve that problem, but what happens when you want to move to a...
summary.zh: 目前应用程序支持有限，但谷歌表示未来会有更多支持。随着越来越长、越来越复杂的密码成为必需品，记住所有这些数字、字母和特殊字符的字符串已变得近乎不可能。密码管理器可以解决这个问题，但当你想要迁移到另一个登录信息管理器时会发生什么？当然，你可以手动将所有登录信息输入到一个新应用程序中，但现在 Android...

body.en: As longer, more complex passwords have become a necessity, remembering all those strings of numbers, letters, and special characters has become nearly impossible. Password managers can solve that problem, but what happens when you want to move to a different login organizer? Sure, you could manually type all your logins into a new app, but now Android can do that for you without the tedium. Google designed the new login transfer process to happen entirely on your phone, so you need the corresponding apps installed with your credentials synced. To start the move, you'll have to find the import option in the app you want to use. The location of that feature will vary, but in Google Password Manager (built into Android), it's near the top under the settings tab. The import option in Google Password Manager will plug in to the new migration system, while export still just creates an unencrypted CSV with your passwords that can be dumped into any app. It will be similar in other apps, so make sure to start the process in the app you want to use. Currently, this works in Google's app, 1Password, Bitwarden, and Dashlane. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 随着更长、更复杂的密码成为必需，记住所有这些数字、字母和特殊字符字符串几乎变得不可能。密码管理器可以解决这个问题，但是当您想转移到不同的登录管理器时会发生什么？当然，您可以在新应用程序中手动输入所有登录信息，但现在 Android 可以为您做到这一点，而无需繁琐的操作。谷歌设计的新登录传输过程完全在您的手机上进行，因此您需要安装相应的应用程序并同步您的凭据。要开始移动，您必须在要使用的应用程序中找到导入选项。该功能的位置会有所不同，但在 Google 密码管理器（内置于 Android 中）中，它位于“设置”选项卡下的顶部附近。 Google 密码管理器中的导入选项将插入新的迁移系统，而导出仍然只是使用您的密码创建一个未加密的 CSV，可以将其转储到任何应用程序中。其他应用程序中的情况类似，因此请确保在您要使用的应用程序中启动该过程。目前，这适用于 Google 的应用程序、1Password、Bitwarden 和 Dashlane。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In our age of rapid technological advancement, the sheer volume of information and the complexity of digital life can feel overwhelming. This new Android feature addresses a practical need arising from this complexity, making digital management more accessible. It reminds us that as knowledge increases, so does our need for tools and wisdom to navigate it.
reflection.zh: 在我们技术飞速发展的时代，海量的信息和复杂的数字生活可能会让人感到不知所措。这项新的 Android 功能解决了由此产生的复杂性带来的实际需求，使数字管理更加便捷。它提醒我们，随着知识的增长，我们也需要工具和智慧来驾驭它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: I turned off my algorithm for 24 hours. Is this how social media used to be?
title.zh: 我关闭了算法24小时。社交媒体是这样吗？

summary.en: An Australian journalist experimented with disabling Instagram's algorithm for 24 hours, seeking to experience social media as it might have been in 2012 before algorithmic curation dominated, where content was less driven by advertising and engagement metrics.
summary.zh: 一位澳大利亚记者尝试关闭了Instagram的算法24小时，试图体验2012年算法策展尚未主导互联网时的社交媒体，那时内容较少受广告和参与度指标驱动。

body.en: Thanks to a little-known feature in Instagram, I try to travel back to 2012 – before everything on the internet was an ad Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast I have a confession. I love my social media algorithm. It is a perfectly curated window into my insane and inquiring mind. It knows precisely which videos will tickle me and which memes will gently distract me from the slow collapse of humankind. On Tuesday the Australian government announced “world-leading” reforms that would force social media platforms to allow users to opt-out of algorithms, dubbed “my feed, my way” . On the same day, I was delighted to be confronted with a video on Instagram of a woman accidentally spilling a bucket of eels on a Chinese train. Dozens of eels slithered among the passengers, who appeared not as surprised as I would have expected. Continue reading...
body.zh: 感谢 Instagram 中一个鲜为人知的功能，我尝试回到 2012 年，那时互联网上的一切都是广告。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 我有一个坦白。我喜欢我的社交媒体算法。这是一扇精心策划的窗口，让我了解我疯狂而好奇的心灵。它准确地知道哪些视频会让我发痒，哪些模因会轻轻地分散我对人类缓慢崩溃的注意力。周二，澳大利亚政府宣布了“世界领先”的改革，将迫使社交媒体平台允许用户选择退出算法，即“我的提要，我的方式”。同一天，我很高兴在 Instagram 上看到一段视频，内容是一名妇女不小心将一桶鳗鱼洒在中国火车上。数十条鳗鱼在乘客中间爬行，乘客们似乎并不像我想象的那么惊讶。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age saturated with algorithmically-driven content, the author's experiment highlights a growing unease with the curated digital landscape. Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, and excellent, a practice that becomes challenging when our online spaces are designed to capture our attention through endless streams of often...
reflection.zh: 在一个充斥着算法驱动内容的时代，作者的实验凸显了人们对精心策划的数字景观日益增长的不安。腓立比书4:8呼吁我们将心思意念专注于真实、良善和美好的事物，当我们的网络空间被设计用来通过无休止的、常常肤浅或操纵性的内容来吸引我们的注意力时，这种实践变得充满挑战。这篇反思鼓励我们有意识地努力去寻找并专注于真正滋养心灵和精神的事物，即使在数字的喧嚣中。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Marvel’s Wolverine review – a gloriously conflicted lead is let down by crude, boring battling
title.zh: 《金刚狼》评测——一个光辉而矛盾的主角被粗糙、无聊的战斗拖累

summary.en: The PlayStation 5 game 'Marvel's Wolverine' features a well-realized protagonist, Logan, and exquisite character art. However, it suffers from narrative and emotional arc lapses, with some combat sequences feeling like a chore, failing to live up to the potential of its dark and bloody character.
summary.zh: PlayStation 5游戏《金刚狼》中的主角洛根（Logan）由利亚姆·麦金太尔（Liam McIntyre）扮演，角色塑造精良，角色艺术也十分精美。然而，游戏在叙事和情感弧线上存在不足，部分战斗体验令人感到乏味，未能充分发挥其黑暗血腥角色的潜力。

body.en: PlayStation 5; Insomniac Games Logan is well realised by Liam McIntyre and some exquisite character art, but there are lapses in narrative and emotional arcs and some of the combat feels like a chore It was always going to be difficult to follow Spider-Man. Insomniac’s three games based around the web-slinger are masterpieces of superhero wish fulfilment, allowing you to swoop above a depiction of Manhattan alive with graffiti artists, roving journalists and gun-toting gangsters. If anyone should be up to the task, it’s Wolverine. A beloved Marvel stalwart, his life much darker and bloodier than Peter Parker’s, he seems the ideal protagonist for a moody action adventure. Yet somehow this well-made game falls short of its potential. Set years before the founding of the X-Men, Marvel’s Wolverine sees a disenfranchised Logan falling back in with Sabretooth and Mystique when their mentor Nathaniel Essex is kidnapped by mutant-hating billionaire Bolivar Trask. This archetypal tech bro has a disturbing plan for world domination and the X Team are out to stop him – but there is a secret buried in Wolverine’s past that’s about to cause an eruption. It’s a decent setup, filled with the sort of intrigue, violence and Freudian tension we expect from the X-Men. Continue reading...
body.zh: 游戏机 5； Insomniac Games 的《洛根》由利亚姆·麦金泰尔和一些精美的角色艺术完美地实现了，但在叙事和情感弧线上存在缺陷，而且一些战斗感觉像是一件苦差事。跟随蜘蛛侠总是很困难。 Insomniac 的三款基于网络投掷者的游戏是满足超级英雄愿望的杰作，让你飞翔在曼哈顿的上空，那里有涂鸦艺术家、流动记者和持枪歹徒。如果有人能胜任这项任务，那就是金刚狼。作为深受喜爱的漫威坚定支持者，他的生活比彼得·帕克的生活更加黑暗和血腥，他似乎是喜怒无常的动作冒险的理想主角。然而不知怎的，这款制作精良的游戏却未能发挥其潜力。故事背景设定在 X 战警成立几年前，漫威的金刚狼看到，当剑齿虎和魔形女的导师纳撒尼尔·埃塞克斯被仇恨变种人的亿万富翁玻利瓦尔·特拉斯克绑架时，被剥夺权利的洛根重新回到了他们身边。这位典型的科技兄弟有一个令人不安的统治世界计划，X 团队正全力阻止他 - 但金刚狼的过去中埋藏着一个即将引发爆发的秘密。这是一个不错的设定，充满了我们所期待的《X战警》中的阴谋、暴力和弗洛伊德式的紧张气氛。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age of rapid technological advancement, even sophisticated creations like video games can fall short of their promise. The review of 'Marvel's Wolverine' points to lapses in narrative and emotional depth, alongside tedious combat. This reminds us that true fulfillment, whether in art or life, requires more than just technical skill; it demands wisdom...
reflection.zh: 在这个技术飞速发展的时代，即使是像电子游戏这样精密的创作，也可能无法完全兑现其承诺。《金刚狼》的评测指出了其叙事和情感深度的不足，以及乏味的战斗体验。这提醒我们，无论是艺术还是生活中真正的满足，需要的不仅仅是技术技巧，更需要智慧以及对真正触动人心的事物的深刻理解。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: UK needs new laws for AI in healthcare, says watchdog
title.zh: 英国监管机构称医疗保健领域需要新的人工智能法律

summary.en: Britain's industry watchdog, the MHRA, has published 44 recommendations for updating policies as the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, including the NHS, is set to become routine. The agency emphasizes the need for new regulations to ensure patient trust and confidence.
summary.zh: 英国的行业监管机构药品和保健品管理局（MHRA）发布了44项政策更新建议，因为人工智能（AI）在医疗保健领域的应用，包括国民医疗服务体系（NHS），将变得司空见惯。该机构强调需要新的法规来确保患者的信任和信心。

body.en:
The UK needs new regulations for AI products used in the NHS and other healthcare settings, says Britain's industry watchdog.

The Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency (MHRA), which regulates all medical devices and licenses treatment drugs in the UK, has published 44 recommendations to update its policies as the use of AI in the sector rises.

The technology will soon be routinely used within the NHS, MHRA chief Lawrence Tallon told the BBC.

"What I would expect is that patients will... increasingly see AI as part of the way that normal NHS healthcare is delivered," he said.

"That should happen in a way that they can maintain their trust and their confidence in what's happening."

The report was compiled by an independent commission and involved input from more than 12,000 people including patients and clinicians.

"The medical devices regulatory framework predominantly dates from a period where we were thinking about things like hip replacements and knee replacements, or smaller things like stethoscopes and plasters," Tallon said.

He added while current guidelines may work for simple AI products trained to spot known symptoms on scans, for example, the rules do not apply to more complex models.

"Unlike most of the medical products we're used to regulating, these products continue to change after the point of authorization," he said.

"I don't think at this moment in time we can point to a single country, a single regulatory framework, and say that they have absolutely cracked it," he said.

AI note-takers known as scribes, which are powered by LLMs, are reportedly used by 40% of UK-based GPs to record consultations and generate reports.

But a recent study from the University of Edinburgh found patients could be less likely to share personal information such as substance abuse history if they knew the conversation was being processed by AI.

Professor Henrietta Hughes, a GP who was part of the report commission, said that many of her patients were happy for AI being used during their consultations, but some chose to opt out.

Prof Hughes acknowledged that the scribes could make mistakes in their notes but said it was the responsibility of doctors to correct them.

While currently AI is more likely to be used to assist with administrative tasks, or carry out symptom spotting overseen by a human expert, there is a lot of excitement about its potential in the health and medical research industries.

Professor Alastair Denniston, an ophthalmologist who also worked on the report, described the technology as "an exceptional opportunity" for healthcare which was "likely to rank alongside step-changes such as antibiotics and MRI".

In September Rene Haas, the boss of chip designer Arm, told the BBC he believed the tech would come up...
body.zh: 英国行业监管机构表示，英国需要对 NHS 和其他医疗保健机构中使用的人工智能产品制定新的法规。 随着人工智能在该行业使​​用的增加，负责监管英国所有医疗设备和治疗药物许可的药品和保健产品监管机构 (MHRA) 发布了 44 条建议来更新其政策。 MHRA 负责人劳伦斯·塔伦 (Lawrence Tallon) 告诉 BBC，这项技术很快将在 NHS 内常规使用。 他说：“我期望患者……越来越多地将人工智能视为 NHS 提供正常医疗服务方式的一部分。” “这应该以一种他们能够保持对正在发生的事情的信任和信心的方式发生。” 该报告由一个独立委员会编写，涉及包括患者和临床医生在内的 12,000 多人的意见。 塔隆说：“医疗器械监管框架主要可以追溯到我们考虑髋关节置换术和膝关节置换术或听诊器和膏药等较小事物的时期。” 他补充说，虽然当前的指南可能适用于经过训练以在扫描中发现已知症状的简单人工智能产品，但这些规则不适用于更复杂的模型。 “与我们习惯监管的大多数医疗产品不同，这些产品在授权后会继续发生变化，”他说。 他说：“我认为目前我们不能针对某个国家、某个监管框架就说他们已经完全破解了这个问题。” 据报道，40% 的英国全科医生使用由法学硕士提供支持的人工智能笔记记录器（抄写员）来记录咨询并生成报告。 但爱丁堡大学最近的一项研究发现，如果患者知道对话正在由人工智能处理，他们就不太可能分享药物滥用历史等个人信息。 报告委员会成员之一的全科医生 Henrietta Hughes 教授表示，她的许多患者对在咨询过程中使用人工智能感到高兴，但有些人选择退出。 休斯教授承认抄写员可能会在笔记中犯错误，但表示医生有责任纠正这些错误。 虽然目前人工智能更有可能用于协助管理任务，或在人类专家的监督下进行症状发现，但它在健康和医学研究行业的潜力令人兴奋。 参与该报告撰写的眼科医生阿拉斯泰尔·丹尼斯顿 (Alastair Denniston) 教授将这项技术描述为医疗保健领域的“一次绝佳机会”，“可能与抗生素和核磁共振等重大技术进步并驾齐驱”。 9 月，芯片设计公司 Arm 的老板雷内·哈斯 (Rene Haas) 告诉 BBC，他相信这项技术将会出现……

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence becomes increasingly integrated into healthcare, the UK's MHRA is calling for updated regulations. This proactive approach, as highlighted by chief Lawrence Tallon, is crucial for maintaining public trust. It echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 27:12, which advises prudence and foresight when navigating new and potentially impactful...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能日益融入医疗保健领域，英国药品和保健品管理局（MHRA）呼吁更新相关法规。正如其负责人劳伦斯·塔隆所强调的，这种积极主动的方法对于维持公众信任至关重要。这呼应了箴言27:12的智慧，该经文建议在应对新的、可能产生重大影响的事态发展时要审慎和有远见。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
title.zh: 谷歌选择芬兰作为其在欧洲的最大单笔投资

summary.en: The US tech giant announces a record €13bn investment in Finland, primarily for AI infrastructure, including three new data centers and an expansion of an existing site. The project is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs and involves a 22-year agreement to purchase electricity from a nuclear power plant.
summary.zh: 这家美国科技巨头宣布了创纪录的130亿欧元投资芬兰，主要用于人工智能基础设施，包括三个新的数据中心和一个现有站点的扩建。该项目预计将创造数万个就业机会，并涉及一项为期22年的核电站电力购买协议。

body.en:
Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.

The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services.

"This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday.

"Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement.

As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.

Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".

Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers.

Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres.

The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028.

"The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added.

"Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties."

Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

The infrastructure will help support products such as its AI chatbot Gemini, alongside services including Search, Maps and YouTube.

Google said the investments also covered "clean energy projects, and dedicated nature and community funds to support local biodiversity, education, research, and workforce development".

"Google is proud to deepen our roots in Finland," said Ruth Porat, president and chief investment officer of Alphabet and Google.

"This investment underscores Google's commitment to grow our presence responsibly, pairing the expansion of our technical infrastructure with new energy capacity, grid enhancements, and energy affordability initiatives," she added.

Earlier this year, Google's parent company Alphabet raised its global...
body.zh: 该公司宣布，谷歌将购买芬兰一座核电站最多一半的电力，作为该国人工智能基础设施创纪录的 130 亿欧元（110 亿英镑；150 亿美元）投资的一部分。 这家美国科技巨头表示，该计划将为三个新数据中心提供资金，扩建现有站点并支持能源项目，以满足日益增长的人工智能服务需求。 该公司周三表示：“这是谷歌在欧洲最大的单笔投资，证明了芬兰在负责任地建设人工智能基础设施方面的领导地位。” 芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波在一份声明中表示：“谷歌的决定清楚地证明了我们的优势。” 作为交易的一部分，谷歌与芬兰公用事业公司 Fortum 签署了一份为期 22 年的合同，购买洛维萨核电站最多 50% 的电力。 本周早些时候，TikTok 宣布在芬兰投资 10 亿美元，在科沃拉建设一个新的数据中心，并指出该国“强大的数字基础设施、清洁能源组合、强大的数据治理和熟练的技术人才”。 芬兰因其凉爽的气候、充足的低碳电力和相对不拥堵的电网而成为数据中心的有吸引力的地点。较低的温度可以减少冷却装有计算机服务器的设施所需的能源。 随着人工智能的蓬勃发展推动了对庞大数据中心网络的需求，科技公司正在竞相确保电力供应。 据谷歌称，谷歌的投资预计将在建设期间支持超过 37,000 个就业岗位，并使芬兰的 GDP 每年增加 36 亿欧元。施工预计于 2027 年和 2028 年进行。 奥尔波补充道：“数据经济的价值远远超出了直接投资的范围，还可以刺激创新、研究和开发。” “深化我们与谷歌的合作将为双方带来持久的利益。” 谷歌将在卡亚尼、穆霍斯和瓦阿拉建立新的数据中心，同时扩大其在哈米纳的现有设施，该设施是谷歌于 2009 年改造前造纸厂后建立的。 该基础设施将帮助支持 AI 聊天机器人 Gemini 等产品，以及搜索、地图和 YouTube 等服务。 谷歌表示，这些投资还涵盖“清洁能源项目，以及支持当地生物多样性、教育、研究和劳动力发展的专用自然和社区基金”。 Alphabet 和谷歌总裁兼首席投资官露丝·波拉特 (Ruth Porat) 表示：“谷歌很自豪能够加深我们在芬兰的根基。” 她补充道：“这项投资凸显了谷歌致力于负责任地扩大我们的影响力，将我们的技术基础设施的扩张与新能源产能、电网增强和能源负担能力计划结合起来。” 今年早些时候，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 筹集了全球...

reflection.en: This significant investment by Google in Finland's technological future, particularly in AI infrastructure, highlights the human drive to build and innovate. It also points to the careful planning and long-term commitments required for such large-scale projects, echoing the principle of entrusting one's endeavors to a higher power for success.
reflection.zh: 谷歌在芬兰技术未来，特别是在人工智能基础设施方面的大笔投资，彰显了人类建设和创新的动力。这也表明了如此大规模项目所需的审慎规划和长期承诺，呼应了将自身事业托付于更高力量以求成功的原则。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Anthropic researcher believes more than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans'
title.zh: Anthropic研究员认为人工智能“可能杀死全人类”的几率为10%以上

summary.en: A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned that AI is advancing so rapidly that he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it could pose an existential risk to humanity within the next decade, a concern echoed in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI safety.
summary.zh: 一家名为Anthropic的安全研究主管警告说，人工智能的进步速度如此之快，他认为在未来十年内，人工智能“可能杀死全人类”的几率超过10%。这一担忧与一系列日益严峻的人工智能安全警告相呼应。

body.en:
A top safety researcher at Anthropic has warned AI is advancing so quickly he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it "could kill all humans" within the next decade.

Evan Hubinger said in a post on X , external the risk from the models which currently exist was "low" but he was "worried" the technology might develop and improve itself soon to the point where it posed an existential risk to humanity.

He did not spell out how he thought AI systems could in future result in humans being wiped out.

But his comments are the latest in a series of increasingly stark warnings about AI, with the debate shifting from whether it truly poses a risk to how big that risk is.

Hubinger's intervention was in response to another post on X , external from Jacob Coxon, an AI researcher who has just quit Anthropic and previously worked at OpenAI.

"These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionise any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources."

Dame Wendy Hall, a computer scientist who advises the UN on AI, told the BBC she was "shocked" by Hubinger and Coxon's social media posts.

She told the World at One on BBC Radio Four some of it could be "PR and marketing" however, as Anthropic and OpenAI raced towards highly anticipated stock market debuts.

But she added: "Why would someone want to say that? I would plead with investors not to invest in this company if that is their value system."

The resignation prompted Darren Jones, former chief secretary to the Treasury and chief secretary to Sir Keir Starmer, to write an open letter to Prime Minister Andy Burnham calling for a new multinational treaty for the safe development of AI.

He told the BBC governments had to come together to "collaborate" about what a treaty based on the development of superintelligence should look like.

"Unless governments take these warnings seriously enough and step up to it, the pace of development could mean that we end up with problems before we've started to look at whether it is an issue for us or not," he said.

Separately, the Financial Times reported , external Anthropic withheld its latest model from the UK's AI Security Institute (AISI), one of the leading bodies in the world for assessing AI risk.

Anthropic has declined to comment on the posts by its employees or the situation with the AISI.

A Cabinet Office spokesperson did not comment on whether the latest model had been withheld from the AISI - instead saying it "continues to collaborate closely with industry partners, including Anthropic, to make models safer".

In his post, which has been viewed more than 10 million times, Hubinger said "we really do earnestly believe" AI poses a species-ending risk to humans.

"I believe Anthropic is trying its best, but we do not yet have...
body.zh: Anthropic 的一位顶级安全研究员警告说，人工智能的发展速度如此之快，他相信在未来十年内，它“可能杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%。 埃文·胡宾格（Evan Hubinger）在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，目前存在的模型的外部风险“很低”，但他“担心”该技术可能会很快发展和改进，从而对人类构成生存风险。 他没有详细说明他认为人工智能系统将来如何导致人类被消灭。 但他的言论是一系列关于人工智能日益严厉的警告中的最新一个，争论的焦点从人工智能是否真正构成风险转向风险有多大。 Hubinger 的干预是为了回应 X 上的另一篇帖子，该帖子来自 Jacob Coxon 外部，他是一位人工智能研究员，刚刚退出 Anthropic，之前在 OpenAI 工作。 “这些很快就会成为超人系统，可以破解任何东西，在一夜之间彻底改变任何领域，并获得真正的力量和资源。” 为联合国人工智能提供建议的计算机科学家温迪·霍尔夫人 (Dame Wendy Hall) 告诉 BBC，她对胡宾格和考克森的社交媒体帖子感到“震惊”。 她在 BBC 广播四台的 World at One 节目中表示，其中一些可能是“公关和营销”，因为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 正竞相在备受期待的股市首次亮相。 但她补充道：“为什么有人会这么说？我恳求投资者不要投资这家公司，如果这就是他们的价值体系。” 此次辞职促使前财政部首席秘书兼基尔·斯塔默爵士首席秘书达伦·琼斯（Darren Jones）向总理安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）写了一封公开信，呼吁制定一项新的跨国条约以促进人工智能的安全发展。 他告诉英国广播公司，各国政府必须齐心协力“合作”，以制定基于超级智能发展的条约。 他说：“除非各国政府足够认真地对待这些警告并采取行动，否则发展速度可能意味着我们在开始考虑这是否对我们来说是一个问题之前就遇到了问题。” 另外，据英国《金融时报》报道，外部 Anthropic 向英国人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 扣留了其最新模型，该研究所是世界上评估人工智能风险的领先机构之一。 Anthropic 拒绝对其员工的帖子或 AISI 的情况发表评论。 内阁办公室发言人没有就 AISI 是否扣留最新模型发表评论，而是表示“将继续与包括 Anthropic 在内的行业合作伙伴密切合作，以提高模型的安全性”。 胡宾格在他的帖子中表示，“我们确实真诚地相信”人工智能会给人类带来物种灭绝的风险，该帖子的浏览量已超过 1000 万次。 “我相信 Anthropic 正在尽最大努力，但我们还没有......

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by the researcher's stark warning, mirrors the biblical prophecy of increasing knowledge in the end times. While human ingenuity can achieve wonders, this verse reminds us that knowledge alone, without wisdom and ethical grounding, can lead down perilous paths. We are called to pursue...
reflection.zh: 研究人员对人工智能发出严峻警告，其进步速度之快恰如末世知识增长的预言。虽然人类的创造力能成就奇迹，但这节经文提醒我们，知识本身若无智慧和道德根基，可能引向危险的道路。我们蒙召要谦卑地追求理解，认识到自身远见的局限性，以及不受约束的技术野心可能带来的后果。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: White House pulls Tetris-style 'Build The Wall' game after copyright concern
title.zh: 白宫因版权担忧下架“叠叠墙”游戏

summary.en: The White House has removed a game from its website called 'Build The Wall,' which used a Tetris-style mechanic for players to stack blocks and 'protect the border.' This action was taken after The Tetris Company expressed concerns about copyright infringement, stating they were not involved with the game.
summary.zh: 白宫已从其网站上撤下一款名为“叠叠墙”的游戏，该游戏使用类似俄罗斯方块的机制让玩家堆叠方块以“保护边境”。此前，俄罗斯方块公司对版权侵权表示担忧，并声明他们并未参与该游戏的开发。

body.en:
The White House has taken down a Tetris-style game on its website called "Build The Wall", days after The Tetris Company raised concerns over its use of the game's likeness.

The game, which saw players stack blocks to build a wall to "protect the border" is one of five arcade games which have appeared on the White House website.

On 4 September the official Tetris account on X posted , external the firm was "not involved in the creation" of the game and it took "copyright infringement very seriously".

The White House has not responded to requests for comment from the BBC or given an official reason for the takedown.

"At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and building people together, not dividing them," the firm said in its initial response to the game.

"To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

The Tetris Company has had previous success in suing firms for infringing on its copyright - settling for an undisclosed fee with the makers of the iPhone game Mino in 2012, which it claimed stole the look and feel of the block-builder.

Four other arcade games still remain on the mini-game section of the White House website.

"Flappy Bill", a clone of the 2013 viral hit Flappy Bird sees players fly a bald eagle and dodging monuments from the National Mall.

Meanwhile in Rio Run, players must "patrol the line along the river", with gameplay reminiscent of the classic phone game Snake.

When players run into the edge of the map, a "Deported" number shows how many people the player was able to catch.

The games have drawn criticism from politicians, with Connecticut Democratic state senator Matt Lesser tweeting , external : "Heating oil is near an all-time high but hey you can play Border Tsar Tom Homan in a video game".

The arcade section is just one example of how the Trump administration has increasingly incorporated video game culture into its political messaging on social media.

In October 2025, the official White House X account drew criticism for posting an AI-generated picture of President Trump , external in a suit from the video game Halo.

Meanwhile on 6 March it posted a video which mixed footage of US military strikes in Iran with film and TV clips, as well a clip from Halo's protagonist Master Chief saying "finishing this fight".

The post was condemned by the Master Chief voice actor Steve Downes in a now-deleted tweet which called for "the producers of this disgusting and juvenile war porn" to remove his voice from the video.

The Pokémon Company International also criticised the White House's use of its imagery in March, when it included a tiny version of the popular character Pikachu in a meme posted online with the phrase "Make America Great Again".

Sign up for our...
body.zh: 白宫在其网站上下架了一款名为“Build The Wall”的俄罗斯方块风格游戏，几天前俄罗斯方块公司对其使用该游戏的相似性表示担忧。 这款游戏要求玩家堆叠积木来建造一堵墙以“保护边境”，这是白宫网站上出现的五款街机游戏之一。 9 月 4 日，X 上的俄罗斯方块官方账户对外发布消息称，该公司“没有参与游戏的创作”，并且“非常严肃地对待侵犯版权”。 白宫尚未回应 BBC 的置评请求，也没有给出删除的官方理由。 该公司在对该游戏的最初回应中表示：“在俄罗斯方块，我们相信联系的力量，并将人们团结在一起，而不是分裂他们。” “致我们世界各地的粉丝：我们爱你们，我们看到你们，我们很感激你们来到我们的社区。” 俄罗斯方块公司此前曾成功起诉侵犯其版权的公司，并于 2012 年与 iPhone 游戏 Mino 的制造商达成和解，并支付了一笔未公开的费用，该公司声称这款游戏窃取了积木游戏的外观和感觉。 其他四款街机游戏仍然保留在白宫网站的迷你游戏部分。 《Flappy Bill》是 2013 年热门游戏《Flappy Bird》的翻版，游戏中玩家驾驶一只秃鹰，躲避国家广场上的纪念碑。 与此同时，在《Rio Run》中，玩家必须“沿河巡逻”，其玩法让人想起经典手机游戏《贪吃蛇》。 当玩家跑到地图边缘时，“驱逐”数字会显示玩家能够抓住多少人。 这些游戏引起了政界人士的批评，康涅狄格州民主党州参议员马特·莱瑟(Matt Lesser)在推特上对外表示：“取暖油接近历史最高水平，但嘿，你可以在电子游戏中扮演边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼(Tom Homan)”。 街机部分只是特朗普政府如何越来越多地将视频游戏文化纳入其社交媒体政治信息的一个例子。 2025 年 10 月，White House X 官方账户因发布人工智能生成的特朗普总统照片而受到批评，照片中穿着电子游戏《光环》中的套装。 与此同时，3月6日，它发布了一段视频，将美国对伊朗的军事打击镜头与电影和电视剪辑混合在一起，以及《光环》主角士官长说“结束这场战斗”的剪辑。 士官长配音演员史蒂夫·唐斯（Steve Downes）在一条现已删除的推文中谴责了这篇帖子，呼吁“这部恶心的青少年战争色情片的制作者”从视频中删除他的声音。 神奇宝贝国际公司还批评了白宫在三月份使用其图像的行为，当时该公司在网上发布的一条表情包中加入了流行角色皮卡丘的小版本，并附有“让美国再次伟大”的短语。 报名参加我们的...

reflection.en: The game's premise, to 'build a wall' using a familiar stacking mechanic, inadvertently echoed the ancient story of Babel. There, human ambition to construct a unified monument led to divine intervention and linguistic division. This story reminds us that even in digital play, our attempts to build barriers can reflect a deeper human impulse toward...
reflection.zh: 这款游戏以“建造一堵墙”为主题，并采用了熟悉的堆叠机制，无意中呼应了古代巴别塔的故事。在那里，人类建造统一纪念碑的野心导致了神的干预和语言的分裂。这个故事提醒我们，即使在数字游戏中，我们试图建造障碍物的行为也可能反映出一种更深层的人类分裂冲动，而非连接。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Javan rhinos survive eruption in Indonesia, but single habitat leaves species vulnerable
title.zh: 爪哇犀牛在印尼喷发中幸存，但单一栖息地使该物种易受攻击

summary.en: Indonesia’s critically endangered Javan rhinos appear to be safe despite an ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau near their last remaining habitat, conservation authorities said. Ardi Andono, head of Ujung Kulon National Park, home to the world’s only wild population of Javan rhinoceros (Rhinoceros sondaicus), said...
summary.zh: 印尼极度濒危的爪哇犀牛在附近的安纳克喀拉喀托火山持续喷发的情况下似乎安然无恙，这是它们仅存的栖息地。爪哇犀牛（Rhinoceros sondaicus）是世界上唯一野外种群的所在地，乌戎库隆国家公园的负责人 Ardi Andono 于 9 月 7 日表示，犀牛的栖息地受到 9 月 4...

body.en: Indonesia’s critically endangered Javan rhinos appear to be safe despite an ongoing eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau near their last remaining habitat, conservation authorities said. Ardi Andono, head of Ujung Kulon National Park, home to the world’s only wild population of Javan rhinoceros (Rhinoceros sondaicus), said on Sep. 7 that the rhinos’ habitat had been minimally affected by vibrations and noises from Anak Krakatau, which began erupting on Sep. 4. Mount Anak Krakatau, an active volcanic island in the Sunda Strait between Java and Sumatra, lies about 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the park on Java’s southwestern tip, and its recent eruption sent ash across parts of both islands, disrupting air travel and prompting some schools and fishing activities to halt. “The Javan rhinos remained safe and still appear normal,” Ardi told Mongabay in a WhatsApp message, adding that his park rangers continue to stand on guard. A female calf of the Javan rhinoceros with her mother. Image courtesy of the Ministry of Environment and Forestry. The number of Javan rhinos remaining in the wild is disputed. Save the Rhino, a conservation group, estimates there are about 50, while Indonesia’s forestry ministry puts the population at 87 to 100. The government’s figures have previously faced scrutiny after a 2023 investigation by Indonesian environmental group Auriga Nusantara found that rhinos not seen by camera traps for years, including some later confirmed dead, were still included in official counts. The discrepancy is significant because the species is confined to Ujung Kulon National…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 保护当局表示，尽管印度尼西亚极度濒危的爪哇犀牛最后的栖息地附近阿纳克喀拉喀托火山正在喷发，但它们似乎是安全的。乌戎库隆国家公园 (Ujung Kulon National Park) 是世界上唯一的野生爪哇犀牛 (Rhinoceros sondaicus) 的栖息地，乌戎库隆国家公园 (Ujung Kulon National Park) 的负责人阿迪·安多诺 (Ardi Andono) 9 月 7 日表示，犀牛栖息地受到 9 月 4 日开始喷发的阿纳克喀拉喀托火山 (Anak Krakatau) 振动和噪音的影响很小。距离爪哇岛西南端公园 50 公里（31 英里），火山最近的喷发使火山灰席卷了两个岛屿的部分地区，扰乱了航空旅行，并导致一些学校和捕鱼活动停止。阿尔迪在 WhatsApp 消息中告诉 Mongabay：“爪哇犀牛仍然安全，而且看起来仍然正常。”他补充说，他的公园护林员继续保持警惕。一只母爪哇犀牛和她的母亲。图片由环境和林业部提供。野生爪哇犀牛的数量存在争议。保护组织“拯救犀牛”估计数量约为 50 头，而印度尼西亚林业部估计其数量为 87 至 100 头。印尼环保组织 Auriga Nusantara 2023 年的一项调查发现，多年来没有被摄像机捕捉到的犀牛（包括一些后来确认死亡的犀牛）仍然被纳入官方统计数字，政府的数字此前曾受到审查。这种差异很显着，因为该物种仅限于乌戎库隆国家公园……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: Even as Mount Anak Krakatau erupts nearby, the Javan rhinos in Ujung Kulon National Park have, for now, been spared the worst. This precarious survival, with their entire species confined to one vulnerable habitat, echoes the ancient cry for refuge. In times of natural upheaval and existential threat, we too can find solace in the One who is our...
reflection.zh: 即使附近的安纳克喀拉喀托火山正在喷发，乌戎库隆国家公园的爪哇犀牛目前也已幸免于难。这种岌岌可危的生存状况，整个物种仅限于一个脆弱的栖息地，呼应了古老的避难呼求。在自然动荡和生存威胁的时刻，我们也能在那位时刻帮助我们的神那里找到安慰。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Court rules residents of a US city don’t have a constitutional right to lead-free water
title.zh: 法院裁定美国一城市居民无权获得无铅饮用水

summary.en: A U.S. federal court has ruled that residents of Jackson, Mississippi, do not possess a constitutional right to lead-free drinking water or truthful information from public officials. The case involved allegations that the city provided contaminated water and then misled residents about its safety.
summary.zh: 美国一家联邦法院裁定，密西西比州杰克逊市的居民无权获得无铅饮用水或来自政府官员的真实信息。此案涉及居民指控该市提供了受污染的水，随后又就其安全性误导居民。

body.en: A U.S. federal court recently ruled that residents of Jackson, Mississippi, don’t have a constitutional right to truthful information from public officials, nor the right to municipal drinking water that is free of lead, a neurotoxin. “The Constitution does not provide redress for every governmental wrongdoing,” Judge Kurt D. Engelhardt of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, who was appointed by U.S. President Donald Trump, wrote in the majority opinion. The case was brought by a group of Jackson residents in 2022 who alleged that the city allowed lead to enter the municipal water system and then lied to residents saying the water was safe, though they knew it was not. “Knowing what is in our water is fundamental to protecting public health,” Caroline Leary, general counsel at the U.S.-based nonprofit Environmental Working Group, told Mongabay by email. Jackson is home to roughly 150,000 people. Nearly a quarter of them are children under 18 who are particularly vulnerable to the potentially life-long toxic impacts of lead exposure including seizures, lowered IQ, impaired brain development and even death. The plaintiffs alleged that several of their children have been diagnosed with lead poisoning and now require special educational, medical, sociological, occupational and disability services. The plaintiffs also argued that exposure to contaminated water and the failure to be informed about the risks violated their 14th amendment due process right to bodily integrity. A November 2025 ruling by a three-judge panel of the Fifth U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals allowed…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 美国联邦法院最近裁定，密西西比州杰克逊市的居民没有宪法赋予的从公职人员处获得真实信息的权利，也没有获得不含铅（一种神经毒素）的市政饮用水的权利。 “宪法并没有为政府的每一项不当行为提供补救措施，”由美国总统唐纳德·特朗普任命的美国第五巡回上诉法院法官库尔特·D·恩格尔哈特在多数意见中写道。该案由一群杰克逊居民于 2022 年提起，他们声称该市允许铅进入市政供水系统，然后向居民撒谎说水是安全的，尽管他们知道事实并非如此。 “了解水中的成分对于保护公众健康至关重要，”美国非营利环境工作组总法律顾问卡罗琳·利里 (Caroline Leary) 通过电子邮件告诉 Mongabay。杰克逊居住着大约 150,000 人。其中近四分之一是 18 岁以下的儿童，他们特别容易受到铅接触带来的潜在终生毒性影响，包括癫痫发作、智商降低、大脑发育受损甚至死亡。原告声称，他们的几个孩子被诊断出铅中毒，现在需要特殊教育、医疗、社会学、职业和残疾服务。原告还辩称，接触受污染的水和未告知风险违反了第 14 条修正案中关于身体完整性的正当程序权。美国第五巡回上诉法院的三名法官小组于 2025 年 11 月做出的​​裁决允许……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The court's decision in Jackson, Mississippi, leaves residents without a guaranteed right to safe water or honest communication from their leaders. This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless words, urging us to seek justice, show mercy, and walk humbly with our God, principles that seem absent in this legal outcome.
reflection.zh: 美国密西西比州杰克逊市的法院判决，使得居民在获得安全饮用水或政府官员的诚实沟通方面，没有宪法保障的权利。这一情况令人想起先知弥迦永恒的话语，他敦促我们要寻求公义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行——这些原则似乎在这项法律裁决中缺失了。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Japan deploys equipment to Indonesia’s Borneo to help fight wildfires causing toxic haze
title.zh: 日本向印尼婆罗洲部署设备以帮助扑灭造成有毒烟雾的野火

summary.en: A Japanese military transport ship arrived in Borneo on Thursday as part of a disaster relief mission to help fight wildfires in Indonesia. These fires are causing a toxic haze that affects people's health in other countries. Japan deployed 300 crew members, the landing ship JS Kunisaki, and three CH-47 helicopters....
summary.zh: 周四，一艘日本军用运输船抵达婆罗洲，作为一项救灾任务的一部分，以帮助扑灭印尼的野火。这些火灾造成了有毒烟雾，影响了其他国家人民的健康。日本部署了300名船员、登陆舰“国崎号”和三架CH-47直升机。这标志着日本自卫队首次在海外执行灭火任务。

body.en: MEMPAWAH, Indonesia (AP) — A Japanese military transport ship docked on the island of Borneo on Thursday as part of a disaster relief mission to help fight wildfires in Indonesia that are causing a toxic haze impacting people’s health in other countries. Japan deployed 300 crew members, landing ship JS Kunisaki and three CH-47 helicopters, which arrived in Kalimantan on the island of Borneo. The mission in Indonesia marked the first known overseas firefighting operation carried out by the Japan Self-Defense Forces, or JSDF. “To this end, we will learn from the Indonesian military’s operational experience and work in coordination and cooperation with them, striving to ensure that the Indonesian people can lead stable lives as soon as possible,” Col. Syunji Nakahara, the commander of the disaster relief activities, said at a port in Mempawah district. Japan and Indonesia have been also increasingly strengthening their military cooperation ties, with the two sides discussing the Japanese sale of its used destroyers. Indonesia has been plagued by forest and land fires for decades, but an intensifying El Niño pattern this year and a prolonged dry season worsened the impact of the fires. Toxic haze and smoke have caused a health crisis in neighboring countries. The smoke has drifted as far as the Philippines, more than 800 kilometers (500 miles) away, and breached Malaysia’s emergency-level threshold for air pollution, forcing authorities to declare an emergency last week in a town in Sarawak state on Borneo. The air pollution has also affected several areas on the island of Sumatra, forcing…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚曼帕瓦（美联社）——周四，一艘日本军用运输船停靠在婆罗洲岛，这是一项救灾任务的一部分，目的是帮助扑灭印度尼西亚的野火，这场野火造成的有毒雾霾影响了其他国家的人们的健康。日本部署了300名船员、JS国东登陆舰和三架CH-47直升机，抵达婆罗洲岛加里曼丹。印度尼西亚的这次任务标志着日本自卫队（JSDF）执行的首次海外消防行动。 “为此，我们将学习印尼军方的行动经验，并与他们协调配合，努力确保印尼人民尽快过上稳定的生活，”救灾活动指挥官中原俊二上校在曼帕瓦区的一个港口表示。日本和印度尼西亚也日益加强军事合作关系，双方讨论了日本出售其二手驱逐舰的问题。印度尼西亚几十年来一直受到森林和土地火灾的困扰，但今年厄尔尼诺现象的加剧和旱季的延长加剧了火灾的影响。有毒雾霾和烟雾已在邻国造成健康危机。烟雾飘到了800多公里（500英里）外的菲律宾，并突破了马来西亚空气污染的紧急级别阈值，迫使当局上周宣布婆罗洲沙捞越州的一个城镇进入紧急状态。空气污染还影响了苏门答腊岛的多个地区，迫使……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The arrival of Japanese aid in Indonesia to combat devastating wildfires highlights a global responsibility for environmental stewardship. The toxic haze from these fires affects health far beyond borders, reminding us that the well-being of creation is interconnected. May this cooperative effort bring relief and healing to the land and its people.
reflection.zh: 日本援助抵达印尼以扑灭毁灭性的野火，这凸显了全球对环境管理的责任。这些火灾产生的有毒烟雾影响范围远远超出国界，提醒我们受造物的福祉是相互关联的。愿此次合作努力为这片土地及其人民带来缓解和治愈。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: NHS reports busiest ever summer as heatwaves drive up hospital admissions
title.zh: 英国国民保健署报告夏季最繁忙，热浪导致住院人数增加

summary.en: Record demand for A&E units, ambulance services, and NHS 111 indicates that extreme heat is having an unprecedented impact on health, according to experts. The NHS experienced its most intense strain ever during the summer's five heatwaves, with warnings that extreme heat is having an unprecedented impact on human...
summary.zh: 根据专家的说法，急诊室、救护车服务和NHS 111的创纪录需求表明，极端高温正对健康产生前所未有的影响。在夏季的五次热浪期间，英国国民保健署（NHS）承受了有史以来最严重的压力，并有警告称极端高温正对人类健康产生前所未有的影响。英格兰的急诊室、救护车服务和NHS...

body.en: Record demand for A&E units, ambulance services and NHS 111 shows extreme heat having unprecedented impact on health, experts say The NHS came under its most intense strain ever as a result of the summer’s five heatwaves, amid warnings that extreme heat is having an unprecedented impact on human health. A&E units, ambulance services and the NHS 111 telephone advice line all experienced record demand for their services in England in June, July and August as Britain experienced record temperatures. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对急症室、救护车服务和 NHS 111 的创纪录需求表明，极端高温对健康产生了前所未有的影响。专家表示，由于夏季的五次热浪，国民医疗服务体系 (NHS) 承受了有史以来最严重的压力，同时警告极端高温对人类健康产生了前所未有的影响。 6 月、7 月和 8 月，英国经历创纪录的气温，急症室、救护车服务和 NHS 111 电话咨询热线的服务需求均创历史新高。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The intense summer heatwaves pushed the NHS to its breaking point, with record demand on emergency services. This immense strain speaks to a collective exhaustion, a feeling of being overwhelmed by the elements. Yet, even in such times of depletion, the promise remains that those who wait upon Yahweh will find their strength renewed, able to soar on wings...
reflection.zh: 夏季的极端热浪使英国国民保健署（NHS）不堪重负，急诊服务需求创下历史新高。这种巨大的压力反映了一种集体的疲惫感，一种被自然界压垮的感觉。然而，即使在如此耗竭的时刻，仍然有应许：那等候雅伟的，必得着力量更新，能如鹰展翅上腾，准备好面对接下来的挑战。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: People in the US: how have you coped during this summer of record heat?
title.zh: 美国人民：这个创纪录的炎热夏天你们是如何度过的？

summary.en: The US experienced a record-breaking summer with heat domes and July being the hottest month in 132 years. The article seeks to hear from people about how they coped with the extreme heat, its impact on their physical well-being, daily routines, and utility bills.
summary.zh: 美国经历了创纪录的夏季，热穹笼罩，七月成为132年来最热的月份。文章希望听取人们关于如何应对极端高温、其对身体健康、日常生活和水电费账单的影响的经历。

body.en: We’d like to hear from people about the impact of extreme heat this summer – and if you’ve had your power cut It’s been a record summer of heat in the US with rolling heat domes and July being the hottest month ever recorded in the country , surpassing temperatures stretching back over 132 years of reliable measurements, to 1895. July’s temperatures surpassed previous high marks set in July 1936, in the teeth of dust bowl conditions, and in July 2012. We want to hear from people across the US on how they have coped with the heat – and what it has meant for utility bills. Has the heat affected you or your family physically? Have you had to change your daily routines? Have your bills soared with the cost of keeping your home cool? And we especially want to hear from people who have had their electricity cut off during the extreme heat or have had trouble keeping up with utility payments. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我们希望听到人们关于今年夏天极端高温的影响 - 如果您停电的话 这是美国创纪录的炎热夏季，热穹不断滚动，7 月是该国有记录以来最热的月份，温度超过了 132 年可靠测量以来的 1895 年温度。7 月的气温超过了 1936 年 7 月在沙尘暴条件下和 2012 年 7 月创下的最高纪录。我们想听听来自美国各地的人们讲述了他们如何应对高温以及它对水电费的影响。高温对您或您家人的身体有影响吗？你是否不得不改变你的日常生活？您的账单是否因保持房屋凉爽的成本而飙升？我们特别希望听到那些在酷热期间断电或难以支付公用事业费用的人们的来信。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This summer's record heat in the US serves as a stark reminder of our planet's fragility and the profound impact of environmental changes. As we face these challenges, we are called to remember that the Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh. This truth calls us to be faithful stewards, caring for creation not just for ourselves, but for all...
reflection.zh: 今年夏天美国创纪录的高温提醒我们地球的脆弱性以及环境变化的深远影响。当我们面对这些挑战时，我们被呼召去铭记，地和其中万物都属于雅伟。这个真理呼唤我们成为忠实的管家，不仅为自己，也为后代去爱护受造界。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Hawaii has often dodged the path of hurricanes. Why did it see so many storms this summer?
title.zh: 夏威夷今年为何遭遇如此多的飓风？

summary.en: Hawaii, typically spared the worst of hurricanes due to its location, experienced significant damage this summer from Hurricanes Lowell and Lala. Hurricane Lowell, in particular, caused widespread destruction on Kauai, including downed trees, power lines, damaged roads, sunken boats, and destroyed piers. This event...
summary.zh: 夏威夷群岛，尽管地理位置特殊，通常能避开飓风的正面袭击，但今年夏天却遭遇了飓风“洛厄尔”和“拉拉”的重创。飓风“洛厄尔”尤其在可爱岛留下了满目疮痍，包括倒塌的树木、断裂的电线、损毁的道路、沉没的船只和被摧毁的码头。这一事件凸显了随着海面温度的升高，热带群岛面临的风险日益增加。

body.en: The island chain has tended to avoid the worst effects, but Hurricanes Lowell and Lala left a trail of damage this year Hurricane Lowell surged near the Hawaiian Islands this week, leaving a trail of downed trees and power lines, crumbled roads, sunken boats and destroyed piers on the island of Kauai. Residents were left to grapple not only with the damage, but the rising risks to the tropical archipelago as sea surface temperatures climb. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管地理位置优越，该岛链还是避免了最严重的影响，但今年的飓风洛厄尔和拉拉留下了一系列破坏。洛厄尔飓风本周在夏威夷群岛附近肆虐，在可爱岛留下了树木和电线倒塌、道路破碎、船只沉没和码头被毁的痕迹。居民不仅要应对损失，还要应对随着海面温度上升，热带群岛面临的风险不断上升。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report from Hawaii details the destructive path of Hurricanes Lowell and Lala, leaving behind a landscape of damage. This serves as a stark reminder that all of creation is affected by environmental changes, groaning under the weight of human impact and a warming planet. As we witness these events, we are called to consider our role in stewarding the...
reflection.zh: 来自夏威夷的报道详细描述了飓风“洛厄尔”和“拉拉”留下的破坏景象。这有力地提醒我们，万物都在承受环境变化的重负，并在人类活动和地球变暖的压力下发出叹息。当我们目睹这些事件时，我们被呼召反思自己管理这片土地的角色，并为受影响的人们祈祷，同时信靠雅伟最终将使万物得以更新的计划。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Flamingo Revolution: The Albanians protesting to bring down the elites – video
title.zh: 火烈鸟革命：阿尔巴尼亚人抗议推翻精英——视频

summary.en: Thousands of protesters are flooding the streets of Tirana in the biggest unrest Albania has seen since the collapse of communism. It began as the “flamingo revolution”, sparked by Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump’s plans for a luxury mega-resort on a public nature reserve island. But the protests have since grown into...
summary.zh: 数千名抗议者涌入地拉那街头，这是自共产主义垮台以来阿尔巴尼亚发生的最大规模的动荡。最初被称为“火烈鸟革命”，起因是贾里德·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普计划在公共自然保护岛上开发豪华大型度假村。但抗议活动随后演变成对总理埃迪·拉马政府的更广泛挑战，该政府被指控将阿尔巴尼亚海岸线卖给精英阶层。马修·卡塞尔前往阿尔巴尼亚，观察一个...

body.en: Thousands of protesters are flooding the streets of Tirana in the biggest unrest Albania has seen since the collapse of communism. It began as the “flamingo revolution”, sparked by Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump’s plans for a luxury mega-resort on a public nature reserve island. But the protests have since grown into a wider challenge to Prime Minister Edi Rama’s government, which is accused of selling off Albania’s coastline to the elites. Matthew Cassel travels to Albania to see how an environmental fight over one island has escalated into a political battle over the country’s future. Continue reading...
body.zh: 数千名抗议者涌上地拉那街头，这是阿尔巴尼亚自共产主义崩溃以来最大规模的骚乱。它始于“火烈鸟革命”，由贾里德·库什纳和伊万卡·特朗普在公共自然保护区岛上建造豪华大型度假村的计划引发。但抗议活动此后已发展成为对总理埃迪·拉马政府的更广泛挑战，该政府被指控将阿尔巴尼亚的海岸线出卖给精英。马修·卡塞尔前往阿尔巴尼亚，了解围绕一个岛屿的环境斗争如何升级为影响该国未来的政治斗争。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The "flamingo revolution" in Albania shows how environmental concerns can ignite broader calls for justice and accountability. When public lands and natural beauty are threatened by elite interests, ordinary citizens can find their voice. May we, like these protesters, demand that justice and righteousness flow like a never-ending stream, shaping the future...
reflection.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚的“火烈鸟革命”表明，环境问题如何能点燃更广泛的对公正和问责的呼声。当公共土地和自然美景受到精英利益的威胁时，普通公民可以发出自己的声音。愿我们像这些抗议者一样，要求公正和公义如江河滔滔，塑造我们社区和国家的未来。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Sargassum Superbloom: Seaweed Scourge or Ecological Boon?
title.zh: 马尾藻超量繁殖：海藻灾害还是生态福音？

summary.en: A massive bloom of sargassum seaweed, stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, is inundating beaches and harming coastal wildlife. However, scientists have found that this floating algae supports a diverse array of marine life, leading some to advocate for its protection.
summary.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾的大规模马尾藻繁殖，正淹没海滩并危害沿海野生动物。然而，科学家发现这种漂浮的海藻支撑着各种各样的海洋生物，这使得一些人开始呼吁保护它。

body.en:
Stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, a massive bloom of sargassum seaweed is swamping beaches and killing coastal wildlife. But scientists have discovered the floating algae also shelters a vast array of ocean creatures, and some are now calling for its protection.

Many of America’s favorite beaches in Florida and the Caribbean have been piled high with foul-smelling seaweed again this summer, often in record amounts. What disappointed tourists may not know is that the inundations, which also smother coral reefs, mangroves, and seagrasses, are just the most visible sign of a vast new marine ecosystem — an expanse of floating sargassum that since 2011 has seemingly come from nowhere to spread in a 5,500-mile-long belt from Mexico to West Africa and Florida to Brazil.

The dense mats of offshore weed grow up to 20 feet thick, and this summer reached a record weight of 38 million metric tons — more than the total weight of all Americans.

The seaweed scourge is wrecking coastal economies in countries heavily dependent on tourism and fishing. The coastlines of 30 countries across the Caribbean and beyond are being visited by the brown mats piling up on beaches, where the weed decomposes, releasing gases such as hydrogen sulfide, with its distinctive rotten-egg smell, and ammonia, which trigger asthma attacks and exacerbate other respiratory conditions. Thousands of victims have been reported by doctors in the Caribbean, especially among workers clearing beaches.

The weed also blocks water intakes and prevents fishers from taking their boats to sea, as well as clogging their nets, engines, and propellers. It has caused mass deaths of marine life on coastlines, while preventing sea turtles from laying their eggs on beaches and blocking hatchlings trying to return to the ocean. The weed also accumulates heavy metals such as arsenic, which leaches out as the weed decomposes on land and can poison water supplies.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

But, while acknowledging its onshore harms, some researchers are now recognizing the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt as a significant new habitat for marine life in the open ocean, and a valuable carbon sink for the planet. According to Jonathan Jung, a marine ecologist at the Max Planck Institute for Chemistry in Mainz, Germany, the weed and its growing army of inhabitants now form “the largest interconnected floating biome on Earth.”

Sargassum seaweed in the Atlantic was once mostly confined to the Sargasso Sea, an area of sluggish waters off Bermuda largely cut off from the rest of the ocean by rotating ocean currents. It has been well-known to mariners since Christopher Columbus reported sailing through “so much grass that it looked like the...
body.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾，大量的马尾藻海藻正在淹没海滩并杀死沿海野生动物。但科学家发现，这些漂浮的藻类也为大量海洋生物提供了庇护，一些海洋生物现在呼吁保护它们。 今年夏天，美国佛罗里达州和加勒比海地区许多最受欢迎的海滩再次堆满了恶臭的海藻，数量往往达到创纪录的水平。失望的游客可能不知道的是，洪水也淹没了珊瑚礁、红树林和海草，而这只是一个巨大的新海洋生态系统最明显的标志——自 2011 年以来，一大片漂浮的马尾藻似乎不知从何而来，在从墨西哥到西非、从佛罗里达到巴西的 5,500 英里长的带上蔓延。 近海杂草丛生，厚度可达 20 英尺，今年夏天的重量达到创纪录的 3800 万吨——超过了所有美国人的总重量。 海藻祸害正在破坏严重依赖旅游业和渔业的国家的沿海经济。加勒比海及其他地区30个国家的海岸线正被堆积在海滩上的棕色垫子所覆盖，这些杂草在海滩上分解，释放出硫化氢等气体，具有独特的臭鸡蛋味，还有氨气，会引发哮喘发作并加剧其他呼吸道疾病。加勒比地区的医生报告了数千人的受害者，特别是清理海滩的工人。 这种杂草还会阻塞进水口，阻止渔民将船出海，并堵塞渔网、发动机和螺旋桨。它导致海岸线海洋生物大量死亡，同时阻止海龟在海滩上产卵，并阻止试图返回海洋的幼龟。这种杂草还会积累砷等重金属，当杂草在陆地上分解时，砷会渗出，污染水源。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 但是，在承认其陆上危害的同时，一些研究人员现在认识到大大西洋马尾藻带是公海海洋生物的重要新栖息地，也是地球宝贵的碳汇。德国美因茨马克斯·普朗克化学研究所的海洋生态学家乔纳森·荣格表示，这种杂草及其不断增长的居民大军现在形成了“地球上最大的相互关联的漂浮生物群落”。 大西洋中的马尾藻海藻曾经主要局限于马尾藻海，这是百慕大附近的一个缓慢水域，由于旋转洋流，基本上与海洋其他部分隔绝。自从克里斯托弗·哥伦布报道航行穿过“如此多的草，看起来就像……”以来，它就为水手们所熟知。

reflection.en: The vast expanse of sargassum seaweed, initially seen as a scourge, is revealing itself as a complex ecosystem teeming with life. This reminds us that even in what appears problematic, Yahweh's intricate design is at work, with creation itself bearing witness to His wisdom and power. As Romans 1:20 says, His invisible attributes are clearly perceived, being...
reflection.zh: 最初被视为灾难的马尾藻大片海藻，正逐渐显露出其作为复杂生态系统的面貌，其中充满了生命。这提醒我们，即使在看似有问题的事物中，雅伟精妙的设计也在运作，而祂的创造本身就见证了祂的智慧与大能。正如罗马书1:20所说，祂的永恒大能和神性，自从创造世界以来，藉着所造之物就可以晓得。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Country diary: A little garden mystery – why are the wood mice hoarding opium seeds? | Susie White
title.zh: 乡村日记：花园里的小谜团——为什么野老鼠要囤积罂粟籽？| 苏西·怀特

summary.en: Allendale, Northumberland: My late-flowering poppies have lit up the garden, and it’s not only me who’s taken an interest The opium poppies have now set seed, their leaves rattling like crisp packets, the vents beneath their pod lids open for the seeds to be scattered. Dotted...
summary.zh: 阿伦代尔，诺森伯兰郡：我园中晚开的罂粟花点亮了花园，而我对它们产生了兴趣，这并非我一人。如今，鸦片罂粟已结籽，叶子像塑料包装袋一样沙沙作响，荚盖下的开口散播着种子。在我的花坛中，在菜园里增添了高度， असतातferum...

body.en: Allendale, Northumberland: My late-flowering poppies have lit up the garden, and it’s not only me who’s taken an interest The opium poppies have now set seed, their leaves rattling like crisp packets, the vents beneath their pod lids open for the seeds to be scattered. Dotted throughout my flower borders, adding stature to the vegetable garden, Papaver somniferum is the breadseed poppy, its large, floppy petals unpredictable in colour: pale lilac, purple, pink or sometimes with fringed petals. The unexpected brings a freedom and a randomness to the garden. Those blue-grey seeds are sprinkled on bagels and bread, baked into cakes or ground as a thickener for curries, adding protein, plant fats and trace elements such as manganese. But in its unripe state this is the plant that gives opium, a two-sided drug, both medicinal and destructive as a sedative – its specific name somniferum means sleep-bringing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 诺森伯兰郡艾伦代尔：我的晚花罂粟照亮了花园，不仅仅是我感兴趣。罂粟现在已经结了种子，它们的叶子像薯片包一样嘎嘎作响，豆荚盖下面的通风口打开，让种子散落。罂粟（Papaver somniferum）点缀在我的花坛上，为菜园增添了姿彩，它是面包籽罂粟，它大而松软的花瓣颜色难以预测：淡紫丁香、紫色、粉红色或有时带有流苏花瓣。意想不到的事情给花园带来了自由和随意性。这些蓝灰色的种子撒在百吉饼和面包上，烘烤成蛋糕或磨碎作为咖喱的增稠剂，添加蛋白质、植物脂肪和锰等微量元素。但在未成熟的状态下，这种植物会产生鸦片，鸦片是一种双向药物，既具有药用性，又具有破坏性的镇静作用——它的具体名称“somniferum”的意思是“带来睡眠”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The garden, a small ecosystem, reveals the intricate workings of creation. Even the seemingly simple act of mice hoarding seeds points to a larger, interconnected web of life. All of creation, in its beauty and its cycles, groans and waits, a testament to its inherent design and its longing for completion.
reflection.zh: 花园，一个微小的生态系统，揭示了造物精妙的运作。即使是老鼠囤积种子的看似简单的行为，也指向一个更大、相互关联的生命网络。万物，在其美丽和循环中，一同叹息等待，证明了其固有的设计和对圆满的渴望。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Baby orangutans found in forest in India spark trafficking investigation
title.zh: 印度森林中发现幼年猩猩，引发贩运调查

summary.en: Five baby orangutans, native only to Borneo and Sumatra, were discovered in a forest in India's Odisha state, prompting an investigation into potential trafficking from Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 五只幼年猩猩在印度奥里萨邦的森林中被发现，它们仅原产于婆罗洲和苏门答腊，这一发现促使当局调查它们是否被贩运至该国。

body.en: Native only to the islands of Borneo and Sumatra, the rare apes were found thousands of kilometres away in Odisha state Five baby orangutans have been found in a forest in India, prompting authorities to investigate if they were trafficked into the country from south-east Asia. The orangutans, native only to the islands of Borneo and Sumatra and known for their shaggy red fur, were found in Balasore district of Odisha state, thousands of kilometres away from their natural habitat. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这种稀有猿类仅原产于婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛，在数千公里外的奥里萨邦发现。在印度的森林中发现了五只小猩猩，促使当局调查它们是否是从东南亚贩运到该国的。这些猩猩仅原产于婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛，以其蓬松的红色皮毛而闻名，在距离其自然栖息地数千公里的奥里萨邦巴拉索尔地区被发现。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of these young orangutans, so far from their natural homes, is a stark reminder of the vulnerability of creatures who cannot speak for themselves. It calls us to investigate and act against the cruel trade that exploits them, ensuring their protection and a return to their rightful habitats.
reflection.zh: 这些远离家园的幼年猩猩的发现，令人痛心地提醒我们，那些无法为自己发声的生灵是多么脆弱。这促使我们调查并采取行动，打击剥削它们的残酷交易，确保它们的保护并让它们重返应有的栖息地。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Chinese Industry Is Starting to Wean Off Fossil Fuels
title.zh: 中国工业开始摆脱化石燃料

summary.en: According to a new analysis, China's industrial sector is showing signs of moving away from fossil fuels by several key indicators. This includes new clean power generation exceeding demand growth and a decline in coal output, with several provinces experiencing reduced coal generation or a significant slowdown in its...
summary.zh: 根据一项新分析，中国工业部门正通过几个关键指标显示出摆脱化石燃料的迹象。这包括新的清洁能源发电量超过了需求增长，以及煤炭产量下降，其中一些省份的煤炭发电量正在减少或增长显著放缓。此外，工厂在工业过程中越来越多地采用非化石燃料替代品。

body.en:
By several measures, Chinese industry is becoming less dependent on fossil fuels, according to a new analysis.

New clean power more than met the growth in demand across China last year, leading to a small decline in coal output, according to think tank Ember. Analysts identified eight provinces where coal generation is now seeing declines, including industrial centers such as Hunan and Shandong, and it named another nine provinces where the growth of coal generation has slowed substantially.

On top of declines in coal power, factories are moving away from using fossil fuels for industrial processes. Textile plants may use gas boilers to generate heat for dyeing fabrics, for instance, while food producers may use gas ovens for cooking. But increasingly such processes are being electrified.

In eight of 11 industrial sectors — including textiles, food, pharmaceuticals, and machinery — fossil fuel use has already peaked, the analysis found. The declines come even as China’s industrial output continues to grow.

“The clean electricity system is gaining both strength and scope, and the fossil fuel system is already registering the shift,” said Muyi Yang, a senior analyst at Ember. “You can see fossil fuel use flattening out, sector by sector and province by province.”
body.zh: 一项新的分析显示，通过多项措施，中国工业正在摆脱化石燃料。 据智库 Ember 称，去年新增的清洁能源远远满足了中国各地的需求增长，导致煤炭产量小幅下降。分析师确定了煤炭发电量目前出现下降的八个省份，其中包括湖南和山东等工业中心，并指出了另外九个煤炭发电量增长大幅放缓的省份。 除了煤炭发电量下降之外，工厂正在逐渐不再使用化石燃料进行工业生产。例如，纺织厂可能使用燃气锅炉产生热量来染色织物，而食品生产商可能使用燃气烤箱进行烹饪，但此类过程越来越多地电气化。 分析发现，在 11 个工业部门中，有 8 个部门——包括纺织、食品、制药和机械——化石燃料的使用已经达到顶峰。尽管中国的工业产值持续增长，但经济仍出现下降。 Ember 高级分析师 Muyi Yang 表示：“清洁电力系统的强度和范围都在增强，而化石燃料系统也已经发生了这种转变。” “你可以看到化石燃料的使用逐个部门、逐个省份趋于平缓。”

reflection.en: The news that China's industry is shifting away from fossil fuels offers a hopeful sign for environmental stewardship. It echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that was made and declared it 'very good.' This transition, driven by innovation and necessity, can be seen as a step toward honoring the created order.
reflection.zh: 中国工业正转向摆脱化石燃料的消息，为环境管理带来了希望的迹象。这呼应了《创世记》中雅伟审视一切所造之物并宣告其“甚好”的记载。这一由创新和需求驱动的转变，可以看作是迈向尊重受造秩序的一步。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

The film, produced by The Guardian, derives its title from an Israeli military term for expected 'collateral casualties' and features testimony from intelligence...
summary.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》聚焦加沙地带的平民死亡人数，在威尼斯电影节首映时获得了长达25分钟的起立鼓掌。这部由《卫报》制作的影片，其片名源自以色列军方对预期“附带伤亡”的术语，影片内容围绕战争中的情报官员和士兵的证词展开。

body.en: The documentary NAZA about the civilian death toll in Gaza was received with a 25-minute standing ovation at its Venice film festival premiere. The Guardian-produced film takes its title from an Israeli military term for expected 'collateral casualties' and is built around testimony from intelligence officers and soldiers involved in the war
body.zh: 关于加沙平民死亡人数的纪录片《NAZA》在威尼斯电影节首映式上获得了长达 25 分钟的起立鼓掌。这部由《卫报》制作的影片的标题取自以色列军事术语，意为预期的“附带伤亡”，并以参与战争的情报官员和士兵的证词为基础

reflection.en: The film 'NAZA' brings the often-unseen civilian toll of conflict into sharp focus, giving voice to those who have suffered immense loss. By centering the testimonies of those impacted, the documentary serves as a powerful act of advocacy, reminding us of our call to speak for the voiceless and bear witness to their stories.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》将冲突中常常被忽视的平民伤亡情况置于聚光灯下，为那些遭受巨大损失的人们发声。通过聚焦受影响者的证词，这部纪录片成为一项有力的倡导行动，提醒我们有责任为无声者代言，并见证他们的故事。

title.en: New Documentary ‘Capturing Bigfoot’ Blows the Legend of the Sasquatch Wide Open — Watch Trailer

summary.en: Marq Evans and Tamir Ardon's deep dive into the infamous Patterson-Gimlin film was an audience favorite at SXSW this year; on National Bigfoot Day, it will finally be unleashed in North American theaters. Fifty-nine years ago, friends Roger Patterson and Robert Gimlin visited the Six Rivers National Forest in Northern...
summary.zh: Marq Evans 和 Tamir Ardon 深入探讨了臭名昭著的 Patterson-Gimlin 电影，该片是今年 SXSW 的观众最爱；在全国大脚怪日，该片终于将在北美影院上映。五十九年前，朋友 Roger Patterson 和 Robert Gimlin 访问了北加州的 Six Rivers...

body.en:
